jobs.description:
About Soum

Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom.

About the Role

Every transaction on Soum generates valuable data: device conditions, car histories, prices, demand signals, and buyer behaviour. The Data & AI Product Manager turns that data into a competitive advantage. You will own the products that price used items accurately, detect fraud, automate inspection and grading, personalise discovery, and give every team at Soum a reliable source of truth.

This is not a role for someone who manages data products from a distance. You will understand data as deeply as a data engineer, comfortable writing SQL, reviewing data models and challenging pipeline designs, while bringing the commercial judgement to decide which problems are worth solving and the drive to get them into production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Data & AI product roadmap, with every initiative tied to a clear commercial outcome such as GMV, margin, conversion, operating cost or fraud loss.

  • Lead pricing and valuation products for used electronics and cars, including instant quotes for sellers, price recommendations and dynamic pricing based on condition, demand, seasonality and market trends.

  • Identify, size and ship AI/ML use cases across the business, such as search ranking and recommendations, fraud and risk scoring, image-based condition grading, LLM-powered listing creation, and Arabic/English customer support automation.

  • Own the data platform as a product: work with data engineering on pipelines, data models, the warehouse and event tracking, with clear standards for data quality, lineage, documentation and access.

  • Stay hands-on with the data: write SQL, explore datasets, spec tracking schemas and data contracts, review data models, and validate that what is built matches what the business needs.

  • Translate business problems into well-defined ML and analytics problem statements, defining offline and online evaluation metrics, success criteria and guardrails with data scientists and ML engineers.

  • Build business cases and make build-vs-buy decisions (for example third-party LLM APIs versus in-house models), including ROI, inference and infrastructure costs.

  • Drive adoption of data products across Commercial, Operations, Finance and leadership, including self-serve analytics, trusted KPI definitions and dashboards people actually use.

  • Monitor models and data products after launch for performance, drift, data quality and business impact, and iterate quickly when results fall short.

  • Ensure responsible and compliant use of data and AI, in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and SDAIA guidance, with appropriate privacy, human-in-the-loop and bias controls.

  • Explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership, and build alignment around priorities.

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of product management experience, with significant time spent on data platforms, ML/AI products or data-intensive products.

  • Data depth comparable to a data engineer: advanced SQL, data modelling (dimensional / star schema), ETL/ELT, event tracking, and familiarity with modern data stacks (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift; dbt; Airflow; Kafka).

  • Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle and modern GenAI: problem framing, feature engineering, model evaluation, MLOps, and LLM techniques such as RAG, prompt design and working with vendor APIs.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with a track record of linking data or AI products to revenue, margin or cost outcomes and building convincing business cases.

  • Has shipped AI/ML or data products into production and can show measurable impact, not just prototypes.

  • Ability to drive products forward independently: setting direction, unblocking teams, and making fast, well-reasoned decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, able to move comfortably between engineers, data scientists and commercial leaders.

  • Fluent English; Arabic is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer or data scientist before moving into product.

  • Experience with pricing engines, marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or fintech risk and fraud.

  • Experience with computer vision or Arabic NLP use cases.

  • Familiarity with PDPL, data governance frameworks or the GCC data regulatory landscape.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.

Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.

Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.

Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.

Develop analytics capabilities for:

Underwriting and risk selection

Claims and loss analysis

Pricing and profitability

Customer segmentation and retention

Fraud detection

Risk and capital analytics

Portfolio and investment performance

Asset allocation

Market and investment research

Financial forecasting

Regulatory and management reporting

Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.

Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.

Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.

Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.

Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.

Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.

Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.

Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.

Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.

Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.

Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.

7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.

Previous experience as:

Chief Analytics Officer

Chief Data & Analytics Officer

Chief Data Officer

Head of Data & Analytics

Head of Analytics

Group Head of Analytics

Director of Data & Analytics

Analytics Director

VP Data & Analytics

Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong understanding of:

Advanced analytics

Predictive modelling

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Statistical modelling

Data visualization

Scenario/stress testing

Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.

Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.

Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.

Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
And now? Now we are looking for a Front-end Developer who will help our Web Development Team create and implement a wide variety of web-based products using Go, , or PHP, and who wants to take their career one step further. If you think you are one of those people, here you will have the chance to work with the world's leading brands using Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning technologies. Right now, while you are reading this, we are sending an average of 2.2 billion requests and almost 2 billion instant notifications to more than 450 servers a day. On the Artificial Intelligence and Predictive side, we have more than 100 TB of historical data. We do not wait for jobs or opportunities to come to our feet — we create them. We have now reached 25% of global users. If all of this interests you, read on for more!
Our Engineers and Software Developers always think with an innovative perspective, taking advantage of the inexhaustible power of the digital world. Our Product and Development teams are located in our Istanbul office, so we produce and develop the technology we export to the world in our own country. jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
jobs.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

  • Ability to create content that drives engagement and retention

  • 5–15 short-form videos per week
  • Fast turnaround times
  • Consistent, high-quality output

Why Join Us?

  • Full-time, stable remote role
  • Work with Australian clients
  • Performance-driven environment with growth opportunities

Send your application to with:

If you're simply cutting clips and adding music, this role isn't for you.

We're looking for someone who truly understands:

  • Attention
  • Retention

On a typical day you might coach a manager through a performance conversation they have been putting off in the morning, moderate ratings for two teams after lunch, and close a leaver's paperwork with the payroll bureau by day's end.

About Contour

Today we operate across three brands with more than 10,000 students and about 500 team members across Australia and India. The India team, which falls under the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building: it runs delivery, automation, people, and operations for the whole organisation.

The GCC is growing faster than the people function behind it. This is the seat that closes that gap.

About This Role

You are the first dedicated people owner for Contour in India: employee relations, exits, performance, pay reviews, compliance, attrition and engagement.

You calibrate across the org and design the process underneath, and you support line managers, who rate their own people and hold the hard conversations themselves. The VP of Global Enablement and Support approves anything where pay or level attaches, and owns org design, headcount and band architecture. The Head of People and Culture in Australia sets the global standard you localise. Everything else is yours.

There is no central HR desk. You work directly with the pod leads, the managers who run each team. This is not a back-office function in a silo: you and the Talent Acquisition Lead operate as one.

Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you can take a termination through unsupervised, and the file stands up without anyone checking it. Second, you hold a position when your approver pushes back, and change it when they are right.

You lead the People team, including a coordinator who looks after HRIS hygiene, onboarding and offboarding, bureau liaison and audit records. We want a player-coach who leads by example, not someone who only directs. You can do whatever you delegate, and you will do parts of it yourself, more in some weeks than others, whether that's a grievance, a POSH inquiry or a termination. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast.

Nobody here yet answers why people leave, what that costs, or whether the paperwork behind a disciplinary case would survive scrutiny.

Where the work lives
  • The HRIS: Rippling and Zoho People are the options, and you have a say in the choice.
  • The payroll bureau: an external firm handles payroll and statutory returns. The filing is theirs; the exposure stays with you.

What You Will Do
  • Take over employee relations once they turn formal: Investigations, grievances, conflict and improvement plans. Managers handle the everyday issues, coached by you; you decide when that line is crossed.
  • Run exits: Paperwork, statutory liabilities, full and final settlement, the record. The manager builds the case and delivers the news; you handle the rest.
  • Operate the review cycle: Design the mechanics, promotions against the career ladder included, then moderate so a rating means the same thing whichever manager gives it.
  • Lead pay reviews: Apply the bands, hold managers to a defensible position within them, and supply the India market data that band-setting depends on.
  • Write the policies people work by: Build and maintain the India employee handbook, from leave and holidays to probation and notice, and the employment contracts, fixed-term ones for interns included. Shape the onboarding that introduces them, and close gaps against the Labour Codes, POSH and the Internal Committee, and state registrations before an auditor finds them.
  • Make this a place people want to stay: Lead engagement surveys with action plans the managers carry and events people look forward to, and track why people leave and what it costs.
  • Coach your people directly: Give each person structured 1:1s and performance conversations, keep routine work from swallowing the judgement calls, and make sure they know why it matters.
  • Plan the next hire: As volume rises, decide what the next role should be and hire for it.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.

What You Need

We weigh what you have built and run more than the years on your CV. You should be able to point to:

  • An India termination you handled yourself: the letters, the liabilities, the settlement and a file that survives legal reading.
  • A contested investigation or grievance where your process held.
  • A calibration across several managers where you moved one off a rating they were attached to.
  • A policy you wrote and rolled out that people actually follow.
  • An engagement project or event you ran that left people more energised and engaged, and how you knew it worked.
  • A call you stood behind against someone senior and were right about, and one where you were wrong and changed it.
  • Someone you managed directly, with the coaching record to show for it, even if it was one coordinator or analyst.

You also know the Labour Codes, POSH and statutory benefits (PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax) well enough to audit where we stand and fix what is missing, even if you have not set up a committee.

If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy doing the work yourself, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.

Nice to Have
  • A compensation round run inside fixed ranges, with market data you defended to a sceptical approver.
  • GCC or multi-country HR experience.
  • Education or EdTech experience.

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on Monday.com. Today we are about 500 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.

The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. The people who do well here care about that and want to know their work made a difference to those students.

They own their work end to end, start things without being asked, and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, including when something is off and what they have already tried, and write decisions down so the next person can pick them up. They give direct feedback and ask for it back.

The pace is fast. Small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle, and whoever spots the problem usually gets to lead the fix. We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own.

We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. Time with us counts, but scope, title and pay move with what you deliver and how much you raise the bar on what you own.

What Good Looks Like
  • Managers get stronger, not dependent: they deliver their own difficult news, and bring you in earlier each time.
  • Nothing arrives as a surprise: compliance gaps, attrition patterns and flight risks surface from you before they surface as an event.
  • Satisfaction you can see: survey scores rise from one round to the next, and fewer of the people you most want to keep choose to go.

Fully remote, anywhere in India, and comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference, with occasional travel. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.

Ready to build the people function India has never had? Apply.

Reviews and responds to attorney reports and recommendations as appropriate. Reviews and approves the defense counsel fee and litigation expenses.
  • Keeps (S)ACM apprised of case developments as appropriate.

Overview

The Director of National Parks requires a software developer to work with the Biodiversity Informatics team to build websites for the Australian National Species List. We require a developer with demonstrated prior experience using frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Next.js, Vue.js, Rails etc) and sourcing data from the backend via API (GraphQL and REST) to build high-quality user interfaces.

An initial 6/7-month contract (full/part time) is available for immediate start, with the possibility to extend for 12/24 months.

About the Project

  1. Purpose

The Australian National Species List Website project will deliver high-quality online user interfaces to taxonomic and descriptive information about Australias unique plants, animals, fungi and other living things.

  1. Context

Background: The Australian National Species List (auNSL) provides an authoritative source of information about the naming and classification of Australias unique plants, animals, fungi and other living things. The auNSL is a key resource supporting the management and conservation of, and research on, Australias biodiversity. Data from the auNSL supports a range of national biodiversity data infrastructures including the Atlas of Living Australia, the Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network, and the Biodiversity Data Repository. The auNSL runs on dedicated software infrastructure built and maintained by the Biodiversity Informatics team within the Biodiversity Conservation & Knowledge section of Parks Australia as part of the Centre for Australian National Biodiversity Research (CANBR) a joint agreement with CSIRO.

Environment: The Australian National Species List infrastructure (NSLi) is delivered via an AWS cloud environment. The NSLi is built on a PostgreSQL database, has a data entry interface (Rails), and provides machine access through GraphQL and REST APIs delivered via Hasura as JSON.

Assumptions: The software developer will work with the Biodiversity Informatics team under the direction of the team manager. The user-interface will be built using a suitable frontend framework (e.g. React, Next.js, Vue.js, Rails etc) and containerised for deployment (ECS, Fargate). auNSL data will be integrated into the frontend via the GraphQL and REST APIs. An open-source headless CMS (e.g. strapi) will be implemented for descriptive information and other display assets to be used on the webpages. At the end of the engagement the Biodiversity Informatics team will be able to take on the further development and maintenance of the delivered infrastructure.

Scope: The software developer will contribute to building the frontend to the Australian National Species List and implementing a headless CMS and API integration for search and data services.

Constraints: The user interface must meet the Digital Transformation Agencys Digital Service Standard including for accessibility, security, and quality.

Every application requires to address selection criteria as part of application submission

Essential Criteria

1.Demonstrated prior experience building high-quality user interfaces for the web using the indicated technologies. Supporting evidence to include URLs for previous projects and code repository with examples.70 %

2.Experience using version control software such as git for source code management.10 %

3.Experience using GraphQL and REST APIs to source page data.10 %

4.Experience with performance optimisation and SEO using SSG, SSR and/or ISR (incremental static regeneration) or equivalent.10 %

Desirable criteria

1.Experience implementing an open-source headless CMS.

2.Experience with containerised deployment in an AWS cloud environment.

3.Experience applying website design principles.

4.Knowledge of the biodiversity taxonomy domain.

Job Title: Medical Science Liaison-Pulmonary-NYC Metro, N NJ, Long Island


  • Location: Remote

About the Job:

The Mission of Sanofi’s MSL Team and the Medical Science Liaison is to be the trusted scientific partners in the field for external experts and decision makers engaging in mutual scientific exchanges to accelerate data dissemination. Sanofi’s Medical Field base teams enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of our products in the therapeutic area and gather new insights by bringing cutting edge scientific exchange today that accelerates medical innovation tomorrow.

Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission- where deep immuno-science meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline –enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-facing role whose main responsibilities are:

  • Scientific Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a trusted scientific partner to Key Opinion Leaders and healthcare providers, conducting high-quality scientific exchanges to enhance understanding of Sanofi's medical and scientific value.
  • Medical Insights Generation: Gather, record, and share insights from stakeholder interactions to strengthen Sanofi's scientific messages, strategies, and product development.
  • Disease Area Expertise: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of therapeutic areas, disease management protocols, and competitive landscape to effectively communicate product value.
  • Internal Collaboration: Partner with Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and other internal stakeholders to support medical strategy, compliance, and product positioning.
  • Evidence Generation Support: Identify data collection opportunities, support clinical trial site identification, and assist with investigator-sponsored studies (ISS) submissions.
  • Congress & Educational Activities: Represent Sanofi at scientific congresses, organize educational meetings, advisory boards, and support speaker training.
  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure full compliance with company, industry, legal, and regulatory requirements while maintaining excellence in all governance processes.
  • Manage a base of approximately 50 stakeholders; developing stakeholder engagement & tracking database.
  • Plan day-to-day interactions, including discussion points in accordance with Medical Affairs strategy, establishing a frequency of interactions per stakeholder per year to ensure that objectives are met.
  • Accountability for the New York City Metro, Northern NJ, and Long Island Territory level with reporting mainly to Medical Affairs Leadership.
  • Executes on defined KOL territory strategy that is targeted to address diverse stakeholder needs (APPs, KOLs, HCP etc.) and is aligned with company medical objectives.
  • Develops relevant territory engagement plans in line with the medical strategy and supports the team’s medical plan execution.
  • Uses approved scientific data during KOL interactions to advance the understanding of the therapeutic area.

About You:

Main Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in a technical, scientific or medical field (MD, PhD, Pharm D,) preferred, or other Relevant Life Sciences Degree (RN/MS) with Healthcare Specialty required.
  • 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry, Clinical Experience, research or medical affairs.
  • Clear understanding of medical practice, clinical decision making and healthcare systems related to patient care.
  • Ability to interpret key scientific data and translate this information to meet educational and research needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to address educational and research needs through delivery of cutting edge scientific/evidenced based data.
  • Understand the design and execution of research studies.
  • Exemplary communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working on multi-disciplinary teams and managing significant volume of projects.
  • Resides within the territory.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrates effective leadership skills (by example and through accomplishments), steps forward to handle challenges within scope of authority.
  • Deep understanding and knowledge of local regulations and codes of practice for pharmaceutical industry, in particular as they apply to the non-promotional activities of this role.
  • Demonstrates scientific expertise - stays abreast of data, treatment trends, and new information in the profession and ability to articulate therapeutic knowledge and translate expert feedback into appropriate insights.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare systems, the evolving medical landscape, regulatory and payer environment, public health and industry trends.
  • Actively listens to others and is adept at confidently stating expert opinion while respecting the positions of others - can exert diplomacy while standing firm on a position.
  • Utilizes effective, professional communications to cultivate strong working relationships with internal and external colleagues, flexible in own approach to people and situations.
  • Skilfully plans, prioritizes, and executes multiple responsibilities and projects.
  • Proficiency in digital tools.
  • Working knowledge of English as a second language.
  • Safe or clean driving record.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Be part of a pioneering biopharma company that engages patients early in drug development and uses their insights to design studies that reflect real-world needs.
  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.
  • Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Research Scientist - Computer Science & Computational Physics

Role Type: Contractor (flexible, Part-Time or Full-Time)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Research Scientists in Computer Science & Computational Physics to help advance a customer’s high-impact research project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify and propose open problems, new bounds, or tractable research challenges in your subfield for rigorous investigation.
  2. Conduct structured research using frontier AI models and agents to attempt proofs, develop algorithms, or run computational simulations.
  3. Systematically verify research outputs by checking proofs, reproducing numerical results, or employing formal tools.
  4. Assess findings for novelty and correctness in direct comparison with recent literature and published results.
  5. Document methodologies, partial results, and encountered challenges through clear and thorough written reports.
  6. Highlight promising new directions and discoveries for deeper exploration by senior research professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced standing in research: late-stage PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career academic (0–5 years post-PhD) in computer science or mathematical/computational physics.
  2. Recognized by peer community for research excellence, such as best paper or dissertation awards at leading venues (e.g., STOC, FOCS, SODA, PLDI, SC).
  3. Strong publication track record within the past three years, including multiple top-venue papers and recent results addressing named open problems or introducing novel concepts.
  4. Hands-on expertise in computational methods, encompassing simulation, numerical analysis, and algorithmic implementation.
  5. Experience reviewing or sub-reviewing for prominent conferences in your specialty is a plus.
  6. Background in leveraging frontier models, agents, or formal computational tools (e.g., Lean, SAT/SMT solvers) in scholarly work.
  7. Publicly shared research statement or homepage outlining specific open problems currently under investigation.

Role Title: Commercial Attorney

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US Based)

micro1 is engaging Commercial Attorneys to contribute to a confidential project at the intersection of law and AI. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. jobs.description:
【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。

2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。

3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。

4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

jobs.description:
关于公司

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球顶级交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。
我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中如鱼得水的优秀人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施——我们正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，共同塑造这一未来。

关于这个方向
这块业务覆盖合约跟单、CFD 跟单、美股实盘跟单，以及现货网格、马丁策略、期限套利等机器人业务，同时正在探索 AI 对话策略方向。这不是一个维护功能列表的岗位。我们需要一个真正理解交易行为、能在产品复杂度和用户理解之间找到平衡点的人。

你会负责什么
1、深入研究新手、进阶、和专业用户如何在跟单、机器人和自建策略之间做选择，并将洞察转化为产品决策
2、与工程、量化研究、AI、风控、设计、运营等团队协同，澄清需求取舍，持续推动产品高质量上线
3、持续追踪跟单交易、量化工具和 AI 投资类产品的前沿动态，形成自己的判断，而不是机械复制功能
4、围绕量化策略方向，推动经典机器人策略优化、策略参数可理解性设计、AI 策略探索、策略表现与归因展示等功能落地
5、围绕跟单交易方向，优化交易员发现与信任体系、跟单配置与风控体验、多品类跟单建设、仓位透明度与信任信号设计

我们希望你具备
1、对交易行为和金融产品有真实兴趣，进入复杂领域时能快速找到核心逻辑，而不是停留在表面功能
2、有较强的独立驱动力；需求不清晰时，你会主动定义目标、厘清路径，而不是等待被推动
3、能理解风险决策场景下的用户心理：为什么用户会选择某个交易员、中途关掉机器人、调整参数或彻底失去信任
4、有清晰的产品判断力：一个跟单界面或策略配置页面有没有把复杂信息讲清楚、风险展示是否会造成误导，你能看出来
5、具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能在技术、量化研究、风控和业务之间建立共识，而不只是在中间传话

加分项
1、有跟单交易、社交交易（Social Trading）、交易机器人或量化平台类产品的完整项目经验

2、对跟单或量化策略其中一个方向的交易工具有浓厚兴趣，是主流平台产品的重度用户

3、有 AI 产品方向的思考或经验，理解自然语言交互如何与专业金融工具结合

4、有用户研究、数据分析或 A/B 实验经验，能将行为数据转化为产品洞察

jobs.title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 交易询价方向
jobs.excerpt: 【岗位职责】一、交易聚合与路由1. 负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.
jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Command & Control Account ManagerLocation: Remote – Based on the West Coast Travel: 50–75%Overview: We are seeking an experienced Command & Control Account Manager with a proven track record in audiovisual (A/V) sales, specifically focused on command and control systems.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Command & Control Account Manager

Location: Remote – Based on the West Coast

Travel: 50–75%
Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Command & Control Account Manager with a proven track record in audiovisual (A/V) sales, specifically focused on command and control systems. This role is ideal for a sales professional who thrives on building relationships, driving business growth, and delivering complex technology solutions to clients in mission-critical environments. The position is remote, but requires extensive travel to customer sites and industry events.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage client relationships within the command & control, operations center, and mission-critical markets.
Drive new business development while managing and growing existing accounts.
Identify client needs and propose customized AV solutions, with a focus on command & control systems.
Collaborate with engineering, design, and project management teams to deliver solutions that meet customer requirements.
Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and presentations to proposal development, negotiation, and closing.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and client meetings.
Achieve and exceed sales targets and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

5+ years of proven sales experience in the audiovisual industry.
Strong background in A/V systems with a focus on command & control environments (operations centers, NOCs, SOCs, emergency response, defense, or similar).
Deep understanding of AV technologies such as video walls, signal processing, control systems, and visualization platforms.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage complex sales cycles and work with both technical and executive-level stakeholders.
Self-motivated and results-oriented with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (50–75%) across the West Coast and other regions as required.

Preferred Experience:

Existing client relationships within defense, public safety, utilities, or enterprise command & control markets.
Familiarity with manufacturers and technologies commonly used in control room solutions (e.g., Barco, Christie, Planar, Crestron, Extron, etc.).
Experience responding to RFPs and government/enterprise procurement processes.

jobs.description:
我们的愿景

作为全球⼗⼤数字资产交易所之⼀（仍在上升🚀），我们在交易、安全 和区块链产品创新⽅⾯提供⼀流的服务体验。
我们的⽬标是让所有⼈都能参与到加密市场的建设中来，使得最前沿的、最有潜⼒的加密货币项⽬得以安全上线并交易。你有兴趣加⼊这样⼀⽀去中⼼化团队吗？

岗位职责

  • 1. 合规产品规划与管理
  • 负责数字货币交易所合规产品的规划、设计与管理，确保平台产品符合各地法律法规与行业规范。
  • 负责分站产品的规划与管理，协同各区域团队，推动产品本地化与合规适配，满足不同市场的合规要求。
  • 2. 合规政策与法规研究
  • 持续跟踪全球主要市场的数字货币合规政策与法规变化，评估与分析对公司业务的合规风险影响。
  • 根据各国监管要求，协调内部资源，推动合规政策落地及产品调整，确保业务持续合规。
  • 3. 合规性与风控产品设计
  • 设计并优化合规功能模块，如用户身份认证、反洗钱（AML）、了解客户（KYC）等，提升平台合规性与安全性。
  • 开发并完善合规工具与系统，提升合规流程的自动化与审查效率，保障用户数据安全。
  • 4. 跨部门协作与需求管理
  • 与技术、法务、风控、运营等团队紧密协作，平衡合规要求与业务需求，推动合规性优化。
  • 独立撰写合规产品需求文档（PRD），并协调各方资源完成设计、开发与上线。
  • 5. 分站本地化与市场适配
  • 负责不同区域市场的分站产品规划与执行，依据当地合规要求进行产品调整与服务优化。
  • 与本地运营及市场团队紧密合作，了解用户需求与市场差异，推动本地化产品开发与落地。
  • 6. 合规性风险评估与监控
  • 参与平台业务的合规风险评估，制定合规性提升计划与应对策略。
  • 监控产品上线后的合规执行情况，确保持续符合各地区监管要求。
  • 7. 合规数据与报告管理
  • 设计与优化合规数据监控与报告系统，确保数据准确及时，为管理层决策提供支持。
  • 定期向管理层汇报合规产品进展、问题与优化建议，提供专业合规支持。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历，法律、金融、计算机、国际贸易等相关专业优先。
  • 2年以上互联网产品管理经验，至少1年以上合规或分站产品管理经验。
  • 熟悉数字货币行业，了解交易平台运营合规性要求及相关法规（如AML、KYC、数据保护等）。
  • 具备较强的合规风险意识，能主动识别并解决产品中的合规问题。
  • 熟悉产品全生命周期管理，能独立撰写PRD并推动产品落地。
  • 具备良好的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能与法务、风控、技术、运营团队紧密合作。
  • 英文能力优秀者优先。

Gate价值观

我们崇尚价值⾄上的原则，您的知识、愿景和⾃主性将在这⾥充分发挥， 我们专注于使⽤最好的产品和服务来赢得全球客户的赞誉，并将去中⼼化的理念带到世界各地。
我们的价值观包含正直、洞察、创新、求知与合作，在Gate我们致⼒于打造独特的Gate风格，并寻找与Gate价值观相契合的你。

我们的公司

Gate成⽴于2013年，是领先的加密货币交易所之⼀，在全球范围内提供 与多种领先数字资产交易相关的服务。Gate拥有超千万的注册⽤户，被认为是全球最安全和最可靠的加密货币平台之⼀。 Gate已经过区块链透明度验证，根据流动性和交易量 ，⼀直稳居全球⼗⼤加密货币交易所⾏列（CoinGecko）。

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Consultant Engineer (Remote/Anywhere)
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are currently looking for a passionate and enthusiastic Embedded Linux Software Developer with Open-Source exposure to join our team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are currently looking for a passionate and enthusiastic Embedded Linux Software Developer with Open-Source exposure to join our team. Your main mission will about providing consulting services to our customers in the areas of Embedded Linux (Bootloaders, Linux kernel, Linux Distros) through software development, integration, debug and testing for different types of products and customers.

Location: Fully remote
Travel: Optional conference attendance

What You’ll Actually Do

    • Upstream & Community Participation: Contribute publicly to open source projects to ensure Collabora's continuing technical leadership

    • Real-World Impact: Analyse client problems and design solutions leveraging open source technologies and Collabora's technical expertise

    • Customer Collaboration: Define and scope client projects in collaboration with the delivery team

    • Breadth When Needed: Gain working knowledge of customers’ products, applications, technical and business strengths and target markets

    • Be a Technical Advisor: Discussing Linux core system technologies with clients and representing the company at conferences and trade shows to demonstrate and promote our leadership in the open source arena

    • Deep Technical Work: Understanding client needs and reconciling time constraints, available technologies and resources, and open source best practices

What We’re Looking For

    Required:

  • Broad Linux experience (e.g. uBoot, Linux kernel and BSP, Embedded Linux Distros (e.g. Yocto, Debian)

  • Knowledge of open source development methodologies and relevant open source communities

  • Knowledge of ARM processors-based embedded systems

  • Experience with System image creation tooling (e.g. debos, wic) and OTA technologies are essential

  • Experience with Debian system creation specifically would be a big plus

  • Experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues in a Linux-based environment

  • Experience with software development for embedded linux systems

  • Experience with modern CI tooling (github, gitlab)

  • Good English language skills (both verbal and written)

  • Ability to work and communicate in an online fully distributed environment

    • Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with one or more of Collabora's market verticals

  • Experience with the Rust programming language

  • Experience with setting up secure/trusted boot chains

  • Experience with creating A/B boot systems or other atomic upgrade schemes

  • Experience with base hardware bringup of new ARM devices

What We Offer

    Compensation & Benefits

    We offer a competitive benefits package tailored to each country, plus a core global benefit offering accessible to all Collaborans. Our core benefits include:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and location

  • Office setup budget to create your ideal remote workspace

  • Sabbatical/Retention of Services – after five years of continuous service

  • Co-working policy – support for working outside your home office

  • Wellness assessments – biannual wellbeing assessments with a trained mental health specialist

  • Conference attendance – we cover expenses and encourage speaking opportunities

  • Open source time – contribute to projects you care about, with company support

Work Environment

    • Fully remote – work where you’re most productive, with a global team across Europe, the Americas, and Asia

    • No on-call rotations – this isn’t support work; focus on engineering and innovation

    • Sustainable pace – we’re here for the long term, with no burnout culture

    • Flexible hours – manage your own schedule and work when you’re at your best

Growth & Impact

    • Upstream contributions – your work directly shapes GStreamer and the broader multimedia ecosystem, not just client products

    • Technical leadership track – path to principal engineer, subsystem expertise, or technical architecture roles

    • Consulting track – develop deeper client relationships, lead customer engagements, or shape service offerings

    • Mentorship opportunities – both receiving and providing guidance within a collaborative team

    • Conference speaking – we support presentation submissions and provide coaching to amplify your impact

    • Recognition – your contributions are public, building your professional reputation in the open source community

Culture & Values

    • Upstream first – we believe the best solutions benefit everyone, so we prioritise contributing back to the community

    • Transparency – open discussion about technical decisions, business constraints, and project challenges

    • Pragmatism – perfect is the enemy of good; we ship quality code that solves real problems

    • Respect for expertise – we trust engineers to make technical decisions and own their work

    • Collaborative – we succeed by working together, internally and with the open source community

    • Sustainable pace – we’re here for the marathon, not the sprint

Our Interview Process

    We respect your time and provide a clear, structured process:

    1. Application Review (within 2 weeks) – we evaluate your code, contributions, and experience

    2. Initial Chat (30 to 60 minutes) – a casual conversation about your background and our work

    3. Technical Interview (1–2 hours)

    4. Technical Deep-Dive – discuss Embedded Linux architecture, debugging challenges, and problem-solving approaches (no whiteboard coding)

    5. Code Review Session – review real patches or contributions together, discussing trade-offs and design decisions

    6. Client Scenario Discussion – tackle a realistic customer situation, balancing technical debt, timelines, and upstream goals (we want to see your thought process)

    7. Chief Operating Officer (60 min) – meet the COO to discuss day-to-day work, company culture, and compensation

    8. Offer (within 1 week of final interview)

    Total timeline: 3–4 weeks from application to offer

    We provide feedback at every stage, and you’ll always know where you stand.

Collabora’s Commitment

    We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive environment. We encourage applications from people underrepresented in tech.

    We evaluate candidates based on skills, contributions, and potential—not pedigree. If you’re unsure whether you qualify, apply anyway—imposter syndrome is real, and you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

    If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

Jeeves is building AI into the core of its financial platform — from intelligent spend categorization and anomaly detection to LLM-powered workflows that help finance teams move faster. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer who is obsessed with building AI systems that actually work in production: reliable, observable, cost-efficient, and genuinely useful.

This is not a research role. You will ship AI-powered features that process real financial data for real businesses. You'll work alongside backend engineers, data scientists, and product teams to take AI from prototype to production — and you'll help define how Jeeves builds with AI as the company scales.

If you've built LLM pipelines, designed RAG architectures, operated ML systems in production, and care deeply about what happens when your AI makes a wrong call in a financial context — we want to meet you.

Location: This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

    LLM & AI Pipeline Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade LLM integration pipelines — including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, output parsing, and chain orchestration.

  • Develop and operate AI features within Jeeves's core financial products: spend categorization, document extraction, anomaly detection, financial Q&A, and automated reconciliation.

  • Implement structured output validation, fallback handling, and confidence scoring to ensure AI decisions meet reliability standards for financial use cases.

  • Evaluate and integrate AI frameworks and tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, HuggingFace, vector databases) and advocate for the right tool for the job.

  • Establish prompt versioning and evaluation practices to ensure AI outputs remain accurate and consistent as models and data evolve.

    • Retrieval & Vector Search

  • Design and maintain vector search pipelines using databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector to power semantic search and RAG-based features.

  • Build document ingestion and chunking pipelines for Jeeves's financial data — processing invoices, receipts, policy documents, and transaction records.

  • Optimize retrieval quality through embedding model selection, chunk strategy, metadata filtering, and re-ranking techniques.

    • ML Model Serving & Operations

  • Collaborate with data scientists to take trained ML models from experimental notebooks to production serving infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain model serving endpoints with appropriate latency SLOs, input validation, and output monitoring.

  • Implement model performance monitoring and data drift detection to ensure production models remain accurate over time.

  • Support model retraining workflows by designing clean data pipelines and feature engineering that can be continuously updated.

    • Backend Integration & Reliability

  • Integrate AI services cleanly with Jeeves's backend microservices — designing clear API contracts, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation patterns.

  • Write high-quality, testable backend code in Python or Go/Node.js to power AI-integrated features.

  • Instrument AI components with structured logging, distributed tracing, latency dashboards, and alerting to ensure operational visibility.

  • Build human-in-the-loop review workflows for AI decisions that require oversight — particularly for high-value financial actions.

    • Collaboration & Growth

jobs.excerpt: Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform.
jobs.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).
Jeeves is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our LATAM engineering team. You will design and build the backend systems that power Jeeves's financial platform — working across payments, cards, spend management, and compliance infrastructure that serves businesses across the Americas and beyond.
This is a backend engineering role at its core, we're looking for a strong backend engineer who knows how to work effectively with AI tools, understands where AI can accelerate development and product capabilities, and is comfortable integrating AI-powered features into production backend systems.
Given the global nature of our business and the collaborative nature of our team, fluency in English is required for daily work with engineering, product, and business teams across multiple regions. Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is equally required — our LATAM teams, customers, and operational partners work in both languages, and you will too.
Location: This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

    Backend Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services that process financial transactions and serve Jeeves customers across 20+ countries.
  • Write clean, testable, production-quality code in Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript; participate actively in design and code reviews.
  • Build and consume RESTful and GraphQL APIs; design inter-service communication using gRPC, message queues, and event-driven architectures.
  • Design and optimize relational and non-relational database schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) for correctness, performance, and scale.
  • Own backend features end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Implement security best practices: authentication, authorization, input validation, and data protection across distributed services.

    • AI-Assisted Feature Development

  • Integrate LLM API calls (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into backend services as product features — such as spend categorization, document parsing, or natural language workflows — ensuring those integrations are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Build backend pipelines that consume AI-generated outputs safely: validate structured outputs, handle fallback scenarios, and design graceful degradation when AI services are unavailable or return low-confidence results.
  • Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate model outputs into backend APIs — bridging experimental AI work and production systems.
  • Use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) fluently as part of your everyday development workflow.

    • Reliability & Operations

  • Instrument services with structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for full operational visibility.
  • Participate in on-call rotation; respond to production incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, testing infrastructure, and deployment practices.

    • Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, compliance, and data teams across multiple time zones and regions — communicating in both English and Spanish or Portuguese as the situation requires.
  • Contribute to a globally distributed engineering culture through thorough documentation, async design reviews, and thoughtful pull request feedback.
  • Bring your regional perspective to product and engineering conversations — our LATAM customers have specific needs, and engineers who understand those markets make our product better.

Requirements:

    Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

  • Fluent in English — professional fluency required for daily work with global teams in written and spoken contexts.

  • Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese — required for collaboration with LATAM teammates, customers, and operational partners.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven backend systems.

  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party APIs reliably in production — including error handling, retry logic, and observability.

  • Experience working on globally distributed teams across time zones and regions.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday engineering work — integrating LLM API outputs into backend services and using AI coding assistants fluently.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or a regulated industry — familiarity with ledger systems, payment rails, or financial compliance (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS) is a strong plus.

  • Prior experience at a startup or high-growth scale-up, comfortable building in ambiguity without heavy process support.

  • Experience with multi-currency systems or cross-border payment processing.

  • Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture.

  • Global work experience — prior roles at companies operating across multiple countries and regulatory environments.

  • Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a meaningful additional asset.

Who we are

BioDigital has built the first cloud-based solution for visualizing the human body in interactive 3D. Like Google Earth for the human body, our cutting-edge technology empowers patients, educators, and professionals worldwide with an engaging, visual way to learn about health and medicine. Our team is on a mission to make health and the human body understandable to all, and we’re seeking a talented, customer-centric Strategic Account Director to help execute on our ambitious goals.

Ideally, you'll have a proven track record in selling and managing cloud-based software solutions, particularly within healthcare, life sciences, or medical technology. Work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and timely delivery of solutions.

  • Provide accurate forecasting and account updates in CRM, maintaining detailed records of client interactions, sales stages, and follow-up activities. Provide insights to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Build value-based relationships with key executive level decision makers by leveraging existing client relationships and building new ones.
  • Represent BioDigital at industry events or trade shows.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5-10 years experience in a key account director, strategic account director or enterprise sales role.
  • Proven track record of achieving revenue targets and managing complex, high-value accounts within a B2B environment.
  • Strategic thinker with demonstrated ability to create account management plans and build trusted relationships throughout strategic accounts.
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to achieve shared goals. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to understand customer needs and tailor solutions accordingly.
  • Inquisitive by nature and interested in uncovering issues to identify business opportunities.
  • Detail oriented and committed to high quality deliverables.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship building skills at the executive level.
  • Creative problem-solving attitude.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams to achieve goals without positional authority.
  • Experience working with B2B SaaS products and/or medical device or life sciences companies preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time for internal meetings, client meetings, trade shows and events

jobs.excerpt: About XsollaXsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry.
jobs.description:
About Xsolla

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit .

About the Role

We’re looking for a Web3 Fullstack Engineer to build the layer where web2 and web3 meet. Our mission is seamless web2 ↔ web3 integration — letting players and developers interact with digital items and move them through their full lifecycle (mint, own, trade, transfer, redeem, retire) without ever having to think about which side of the chain they’re on. You’ll work across the whole stack: wallet-connected frontends, high-throughput backend services, and the smart contract and indexing layers that make on-chain items feel as fast and familiar as anything in web2.

This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. A player buying an item with a credit card, a game granting an in-game asset, and a marketplace settling a peer-to-peer trade should all resolve to the same coherent item model — regardless of whether the item lives in a database, a custodial wallet, or on-chain. Making that experience invisible to the end user, and reliable for the developer, is the core of the job.

You care about product quality and developer experience as much as protocol correctness. You’re comfortable owning a feature end to end, reasoning about trust and custody boundaries, and making pragmatic calls about what belongs on-chain versus off-chain.

Responsibilities

    Build Seamless Web2 ↔ Web3 Integration — Design and ship the flows that let users move between traditional accounts/payments and on-chain wallets without friction: custodial and non-custodial wallets, account abstraction, gasless transactions, and fiat on-ramps.

    Own the Digital Item Lifecycle — Build the systems behind item mint, ownership, transfer, trading, and redemption — keeping on-chain state and off-chain records consistent, auditable, and fast.

    Develop Fullstack Features — Deliver end to end across wallet-connected frontends, backend services, and the smart contract / indexing layer that powers item ownership and turnover.

    Model Items & Ownership — Design data models and APIs that represent items uniformly whether they live off-chain, in a custodial wallet, or on-chain, and keep them in sync.

    Ensure Reliability of Value Flows — Anything that moves items or money must be correct under failure: idempotency, reconciliation, replay safety, and clear recovery paths.

    Integrate Blockchains & Marketplaces — Interact with EVM chains, token standards, indexers, and marketplace/settlement flows; abstract their differences behind clean internal interfaces.

    Collaborate Across Teams — Work with product, security, payments, and game-facing teams to turn business needs into well-scoped technical plans, and document decisions so they stand on their own.

What You Bring

    Web3 & Digital Assets

    Web2 ↔ Web3 Integration — Hands-on experience bridging traditional systems with on-chain ones: wallet onboarding, custodial vs. non-custodial trade-offs, account abstraction, gasless/relayed transactions.

    EVM & Smart Contracts — Working knowledge of EVM chains and Solidity, including reading, integrating with, and reasoning about the safety of contracts.

    Token & Item Standards — Practical understanding of ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155, and how they map to real game items, ownership, and transfers.

    On-chain / Off-chain Sync — Experience keeping blockchain state consistent with off-chain databases: indexing, event ingestion, reorg handling, and reconciliation.

    Frontend Engineering

    TypeScript & React — Strong TypeScript and React skills for building responsive, production-grade interfaces.

    Wallet Integration — Experience with wallet connectivity and web3 client libraries (e.g. wagmi, viem, ethers.js, WalletConnect) and embedded/social login wallets.

    Backend Engineering

    Backend Services — Solid backend skills in Node.js and Go: clean APIs, concurrency, and performance under load.

    Distributed Systems — Experience with distributed systems and their trade-offs (consistency, availability, failure modes), especially where correctness of value transfer matters.

    Data & Infrastructure

    PostgreSQL — Schema design, query optimization, and migrations at scale.

    Kubernetes — Deploying, operating, and debugging services in a k8s environment.

    Message Streaming — Kafka or NATS — event-driven patterns, consumer groups, at-least-once delivery.

    Git & CI/CD — Git and modern CI/CD practices.

    Domain Context

    Gaming Industry Experience — Experience building or operating platforms for game developers, publishers, or players — especially anything touching in-game items, economies, or ownership.

Nice to Have

    • Experience building NFT marketplaces, item trading, or secondary-market / settlement systems
    • Familiarity with blockchain indexing tooling (The Graph, custom indexers) and node/RPC infrastructure
    • Experience with account abstraction (ERC-4337), smart wallets, or paymaster/relayer setups
    • Background in payments or fiat on-ramp integration bridging traditional commerce and crypto
    • Experience with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, etc.) or cross-chain / bridging patterns
    • Familiarity with security and compliance relevant to digital assets: custody, key management, audit logging, KYC/AML touchpoints
    • Contributions to open-source web3, wallet, or tooling projects
    • Hands-on, up-to-date experience with modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and accelerating day-to-day engineering work

How We Work

    Xsolla operates across multiple time zones, and the systems you build sit directly in the path of real value moving between users, games, and chains. Strong written communication is essential — your designs and decisions need to stand on their own and be actionable without you in the room.

    We value directness, technical depth, and follow-through. If a design or production issue has real security, correctness, or reliability implications — especially anything touching item ownership or the movement of value — we expect you to say so clearly, defend your position with evidence, and stay engaged until it’s resolved.
