jobs.excerpt: About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

Our Core Technologies

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

What You'll Do

  • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout
  • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge
  • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff
  • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most
  • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs
  • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers
  • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context
  • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior
  • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts
  • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone
  • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For:

  • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles
  • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails
  • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates
  • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.
  • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved
  • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response
  • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have:

  • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)
  • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling
  • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design
  • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)
  • Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Développeur/Développeuse logiciel senior (Bases de données)
jobs.excerpt: Aperçu du rôleLorsque les radiologues reçoivent le bon examen au bon moment, les patients obtiennent des réponses plus rapidement.
jobs.description:
Aperçu du rôle

Lorsque les radiologues reçoivent le bon examen au bon moment, les patients obtiennent des réponses plus rapidement. Derrière chaque liste de travail, recherche et attribution se trouve une base de données qui doit répondre rapidement et avec précision. À titre de Développeur/Développeuse logiciel senior spécialisé en bases de données au sein de l’équipe InteleOrchestrator, vous contribuerez à moderniser une plateforme reposant sur Microsoft SQL Server qui simplifie les flux de travail en radiologie pour les établissements de santé partout dans le monde.

Vous développerez les solutions qui font évoluer la base de données : refonte de schémas et de requêtes, simplification de couches d’accès aux données héritées et migration vers des approches fortement typées et rigoureusement testées, tout en maintenant les systèmes opérationnels pour les cliniciens.

Il s’agit d’un rôle de développement logiciel pratique, et non d’un poste d’administration de bases de données. Votre temps sera consacré au code, aux plans d’exécution SQL et aux revues de code plutôt qu’aux sauvegardes, aux mises à jour de serveurs ou aux opérations d’infrastructure.

La réussite dans ce poste se traduit par un accès aux données plus rapide, plus sécuritaire et plus facile à maintenir, réduisant ainsi la charge administrative et permettant aux cliniciens de consacrer davantage de temps aux soins des patients.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger des projets complexes de refonte de bases de données au sein d’un schéma SQL Server mature et de grande envergure, notamment en restructurant des tables, clés et index, en éliminant des structures héritées et en normalisant les données au moyen de migrations incrémentales sécurisées et versionnées (par exemple avec Liquibase), sans interruption des opérations cliniques.

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes de performance à la source en analysant les plans d’exécution, en optimisant les requêtes SQL, en remplaçant les traitements ligne par ligne par des traitements par lots, et en concevant des stratégies d’indexation adaptées aux charges de travail réelles.

  • Moderniser la couche d’accès aux données en migrant du SQL hérité et du SQL intégré dans du code PHP et C# vers des dépôts Kotlin et jOOQ fortement typés, tout en préservant les comportements existants grâce à des tests de caractérisation, de régression et de montée en charge.

  • Renforcer la sécurité et la fiabilité de l’accès aux données en éliminant les vulnérabilités liées aux injections SQL, en appliquant des pratiques cohérentes de verrouillage, d’isolation et de gestion des délais d’exécution, et en mettant en place des mécanismes de diagnostic permettant de relier l’activité de la base de données au code qui la génère.

  • Développer les outils facilitant les changements de schéma et les déploiements, notamment des pipelines de migration et de mise à niveau basés sur Gradle et CI/CD, des environnements de test SQL Server conteneurisés et des contrôles automatisés permettant de détecter les régressions avant la mise en production.

  • Contribuer à l’orientation technique de la plateforme en définissant les normes SQL et les standards d’accès aux données, en documentant les conventions et en participant aux décisions d’architecture ainsi qu’à l’évolution de la feuille de route technique d’InteleOrchestrator.

  • Collaborer avec les autres développeurs et les accompagner par le biais de revues de code, de partages de connaissances et de mentorat technique afin de favoriser le développement de code d’accès aux données performant, sécurisé et maintenable.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, dont au moins 4 ans consacrés au développement et à la refonte de bases de données en environnement de production (SQL, schémas et couches d’accès aux données).
  • Maîtrise avancée de T-SQL sous Microsoft SQL Server, incluant l’optimisation de requêtes, l’analyse de plans d’exécution, les stratégies d’indexation, les tables temporaires, les CTE, les fonctions analytiques (window functions), les procédures stockées et la conception orientée ensembles de données. Une expérience avec PostgreSQL est également un atout.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la modernisation progressive de schémas relationnels complexes et hérités ainsi que du code applicatif qui en dépend, dans des environnements déjà en production.
  • Maîtrise de Kotlin ou Java, ou d’un langage équivalent, pour le développement de services back-end utilisant Spring Boot ou un cadre similaire.
  • Expérience pratique avec des outils de migration et de gestion de versions de bases de données tels que Liquibase ou Flyway, intégrés à des pipelines CI/CD basés sur Git.
  • Excellente compréhension de la concurrence, des mécanismes de verrouillage, des niveaux d’isolation et de l’intégrité transactionnelle, ainsi que de leur impact sur le comportement des applications sous charge.
  • Solides connaissances des pratiques sécuritaires d’accès aux données, notamment la prévention des injections SQL et la protection des renseignements sensibles des patients.
  • Expérience au sein d’équipes Agile utilisant Gradle, Git et des pratiques modernes DevOps dans des environnements Windows et Linux.

Qualifications souhaitées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience avec jOOQ ou des bibliothèques SQL fortement typées similaires, ainsi qu’avec la génération de code à partir de schémas de bases de données.
  • Expérience dans la lecture, la maintenance ou la migration de code hérité en PHP et/ou C# (.NET).
  • Expérience avec des approches de tests de bases de données telles que Testcontainers, les environnements SQL Server basés sur Docker, les tests de caractérisation (« golden master ») et les tests de charge ou de montée en capacité.
  • Connaissance des outils de diagnostic SQL Server (Query Store, DMV, Extended Events) ainsi que des plateformes d’observabilité telles que Datadog ou New Relic.
  • Expérience avec les services de données AWS, notamment Amazon RDS pour SQL Server.
  • Expérience des normes de données en santé telles que HL7 et DICOM, ou dans d’autres industries réglementées (FDA, FAA ou équivalent).
  • Lieu : Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats résidant au Canada ou aux États-Unis.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $100,000 to $135,000/yr CAD. Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Intelerad est une entreprise qui offre une rémunération globale. Le salaire dépend du poste proposé. About Somewear Labs

Somewear Labs builds communication and unmanned systems technology for mission-critical operations in challenging environments.

Job Summary

The Mission Support Engineer – Unmanned is a hands-on, forward-deployed technical expert who owns the success of our unmanned system deployments — from pre-mission preparation through execution and recovery. You will isolate failures across the vehicle, onboard compute, Horizon hardware, payloads, and communications equipment, implement safe field solutions, and enable operators to employ the capability confidently on their own.

Key Responsibilities

Mission Support & Field Execution

  • Own technical execution of unmanned systems trials, evaluations, demonstrations, exercises, and operational deployments.

  • Serve as the on-site technical owner for system readiness, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and mission performance.

  • Conduct pre-mission checks, equipment preparation, software installation, and readiness assessments; support post-mission recovery, discrepancy identification, documentation, and after-action review.

  • Translate mission requirements into practical unmanned system, compute, communications, and payload integration requirements.

  • Drive issues to resolution in the field using structured troubleshooting and sound engineering judgment.

Unmanned Systems Integration & Hardware Troubleshooting

  • Configure, operate, maintain, integrate, and troubleshoot unmanned systems and associated mission equipment.

  • Isolate failures across the vehicle, onboard compute, Horizon hardware, payloads, and communications equipment.

  • Troubleshoot power, cabling, connectors, pinouts, and data interfaces using technical documentation and a multimeter or similar diagnostic equipment.

  • Make safe field repairs, wiring changes, or integration adjustments when necessary to restore mission capability.

Customer Operations Automation LeadRemote (India) | Contour EducationAlso searched as: CX Automation Specialist, AI Solutions Engineer, AI Automation Engineer, Conversational AI Developer, Chatbot Developer, CRM Automation Engineer, AI Implementation Specialist, HubSpot Automation Specialist, Customer Support Automation, AI Automation Consultant, Customer Service AI Specialist We have six customer inboxes handling thousands of student and family queries: email, web forms, tickets, and (later) calls.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Customer Operations Automation Lead

Remote (India) | Contour Education

Also searched as: CX Automation Specialist, AI Solutions Engineer, AI Automation Engineer, Conversational AI Developer, Chatbot Developer, CRM Automation Engineer, AI Implementation Specialist, HubSpot Automation Specialist, Customer Support Automation, AI Automation Consultant, Customer Service AI Specialist

We have six customer inboxes handling thousands of student and family queries: email, web forms, tickets, and (later) calls.Today, humans answer every single one. We want an AI and automationlayer that handles the routine volume so humans only touch what genuinely needs a human.

If you have builtcustomer automation before, even once, and you can show us what you shipped and what it changed, this is for you.

Your first task is a real one.Part of our process is showing you our actual billing or service inbox and asking how you would automate it. No abstract case study. The real thing. If that sounds fun rather than annoying, we will get along.

Full-time or contract, your call.Come build it and move on, or build it and stay to run it. Tell us what suits you.

The Core Skill

You look at a wall of repetitive queries and see a system waiting to be built. Specifically, you can:

  • Build a knowledge base an AI agent can actually answer from

  • Configure AI agents, chatbots, and automated routing (we run HubSpot, so Breeze or whatever works best within it)

  • Decide what gets automated, what gets a human, and where the handoff sits

  • Track deflection rates and push them up over time.

Years are not the point. As long as you've built and shipped solutions, that's what we care about, not tenure or years of experience. We know AI, inbox automation, and similar capabilities are newer frontiers, so six months of real work in that space counts as much as five claimed years elsewhere. What matters is you have done it, you know why it worked, and you want to do it again at a bigger scale with real ownership.

About Contour

Australian EdTech company, 8,000+ students across three brands, growing fast. Our customer inbox operation needs to scale without just throwing more people at it. That is the job.

What You Will Do
  • Build the automation layer for six inboxes.Sales, Student Experience, Service, Billing, Program Consulting, Academic Operations. Text channels first (email, forms, tickets), voice later. You set up the system that handles routine volume on its own.
  • Build the knowledge base behind it.Every AI response runs on what you document: decision frameworks, edge cases, escalation logic. This is the foundation and you own its quality.
  • Own the tooling decisions.HubSpot is the CRM and it is staying. Breeze, custom workflows, third-party tools on top, or a mix is your call. Best result wins, factoring in setup time and maintenance.
  • Own the numbers.Deflection rate, AI resolution rate, cost per interaction, response time. You build the dashboards and move the numbers every week.
  • Make humans and AI work together.Some queries always need a person. There is a team for that. You make the system run as a whole. Want to manage the team too? Great. Would rather just build? We will structure the team around you.

The Stack

HubSpot (CRM, Service Hub, Breeze available), HubSpot Emails, Make for cross-system automation, Aircall for voice (later phase), Monday.com and Missive as interim tools transitioning into HubSpot, Stripe behind billing.

You do not need all of these. You need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool in a week. And the stack is a starting point: HubSpot as the CRM is fixed, everything else is open. Know a better tool? Bring it. If the cost and maintenance make sense, we will try it.

​


Requirements

How We Work
  • Independent, inside frameworks.You make calls and move fast, within guardrails we set together.
  • Obsessed with metrics.We bring numbers, not vibes, to every conversation and let the data drive the decision.
  • We love the mess.Half-built environment, knowledge in people's heads, systems mid-migration. You walk in and bring the order.

What Else We Look For
  • You are an operator.Relentlessly resourceful with your own time. Faced with a blank-page knowledge base, you would point AI at our existing emails to pull out our tone and most common answers, then go from there. You use AI to speed up your own work, the same way you use it to run the inbox. You find the shortcut, use the tool, and get there in days, not weeks.
  • You think in systems.Repetitive query, your instinct is to build something that kills it for good.
  • You are hands-on.You write the knowledge base article, fix the chatbot response at 9pm, test the flow yourself. You build and you run.
  • You write sharp English.The AI you build talks to students and families. You set the standard for how it sounds.

Helpful, Not Required

  • HubSpot (especially Service Hub or Breeze)

  • EdTech or student-facing ops background

  • Voice/telephony automation (a plus, voice is on the roadmap)

  • Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar

Where We Are Flexible

  • Experience length.AI customer ops is new. As long as you've built and shipped solutions, that's what we care about, not tenure or years of experience. We know AI, inbox automation, and similar capabilities are newer frontiers, so six months of real work in that space counts as much as five claimed years elsewhere.

  • Background.Build the system and the team forms around you. People management is welcome, not required.

  • Stack.Any tools, as long as you have built automation that worked.


Benefits

Your First 90 Days

Six inboxes, thousands of queries, all human-handled today. No knowledge base, no automation. By month 3: you have audited the volume, built the knowledge base, and automated the highest-volume routine queries on the text channels, with deflection numbers you are tracking and improving. Voice after that. How you get there is yours to define.

Compensation & Engagement

Senior technical compensation, with real flexibility for an exceptional builder. We pay well for someone who can genuinely ship this. Whether you want a salary or a contract day rate, we will work with what suits you. Specifics shared early in the process.

Working Hours

Fully remote, anywhere in India with a couple of weekly syncs with our Australian team.

Contour Education is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from across India regardless of location, background, or educational institution.

Treasury Analyst & Project Lead

The location for this role is flexible within Africa, with a strong preference for one of Enko Education's countries of operation.

Enko Education is a fast-growing network of African International Schools operating across 11 African countries. Our mission is to increase access to world-class education for talented learners across the continent.

We are currently launching a strategic milestone: the creation and deployment of our Shared Service Centre (SSC) to centralize our treasury, finance, and accounts payable operations. In this context, the Group Treasury Analyst & Project Lead is a foundational hire. You will join a lean, agile team at a unique corporate moment—a stage where processes and structures are being built, shaped, and deployed from scratch, not just inherited.

Your Mission

Directly reporting to the Group Treasurer, your mission is dual: owning the daily group corporate treasury operations and actively driving the implementation of our new Shared Service Centre framework.

As a master of cash management and a structured project builder, you will guarantee data integrity across our multi-country operations, manage liquidity forecasting, and ensure flawless treasury controls. You won’t just manage numbers; you will act as a key change agent and the operational gatekeeper of our financial infrastructure.

This is a highly entrepreneurial corporate finance role designed for a proactive analyst with a "builder" mindset who thrives on ownership, structural design, and cross-functional collaboration.

Core Responsibilities

1. SSC Implementation & Project Management

  • Framework Deployment: Actively support the Group Treasurer in designing, documenting, and implementing the workflows, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the new Shared Service Centre.
  • Process Optimization: Identify structural gaps in local school reporting, propose agile optimization solutions, and drive the transition toward centralized treasury standards.
  • Change Management: Act as a central point of contact to ensure smooth onboarding and training of local School Finance Partners into the new centralized systems.

2. Cash Flow Forecasting & Liquidity Management

  • Model Ownership: Lead and manage the 12-week rolling cash flow forecast for all schools and holding entities.
  • Data Integrity & Gatekeeping: Review financial submissions from School Finance Partners, actively challenging assumptions and pushing back on inconsistencies to ensure absolute data quality.
  • Cash Committee Leadership: Prepare and co-lead the weekly cash meeting pack (covering group cash positions, actual vs. forecast variances, accounts payable ageing highlights, and proposed payment runs).

3. Debt Management & Compliance

  • Master Schedule Oversight: Maintain and reconcile the Master Debt Schedule against Xero and underlying loan agreements (tracking principal repayments, interest schedules, and maturities).
  • Lender Relations Support: Ensure all debt service obligations are seamlessly integrated into liquidity forecasts and assist in preparing lender reporting packs.

4. Treasury Controls & Governance

  • Mandate Repository: Maintain a pristine, up-to-date central register of every Enko bank account, authorized signatory, and corporate limit across all jurisdictions.
  • Compliance: Review all new bank account opening packs for compliance and accuracy before formal corporate submission.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a "Hands-on Strategist" who balances deep analytical rigor with the agility and project management skills needed to build a function from the ground up.

  • Your Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in corporate treasury, financial analysis, or an analytical corporate finance role, ideally coupled with exposure to project management or Shared Service Centre implementations.
  • Project Management Skills: Highly structured, organized, and capable of setting up processes, documenting workflows, and managing transition timelines.
  • Technical Savvy: Advanced mastery of Excel / Google Sheets is non-negotiable. Experience with cloud accounting ecosystems (such as Xero) is highly expected.
  • Languages:Full professional proficiency in both English and French is required. Operating in a multicultural and multilingual environment, you must be fully comfortable leading technical discussions, writing reports, and collaborating with stakeholders in both languages.
  • The "Ownership" Mindset: You completely own your numbers. You possess the emotional intelligence and communication skills needed to confidently defend forecast assumptions, handle pushbacks, and challenge senior school stakeholders.
  • Geographical Flexibility: Exposure to African banking landscapes, local FX constraints, and multi-country environments is a significant asset.

Why Join Us?

  • Direct Visibility & Impact: Work hand-in-hand with the Group Treasurer with direct visibility from the CFO, offering an unparalleled learning curve early in your career.
  • Blank Canvas: A rare opportunity to help build a centralized treasury function from scratch within a fast-growing multi-country group.
  • Mission with Purpose: Contribute to a value-driven organization that is genuinely transforming the future of education across the African continent.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Culture Fit Interview: To align on our mission, culture, and values.
  2. Technical Case Study: A practical exercise focused on cash forecasting logic, variance analysis, and problem-solving.
  3. Technical Interview: A deep dive into treasury fundamentals, debt schedules, and your vision for the role with the Group Treasurer.
  4. Career Interview: A discussion centered around your professional trajectory and long-term ambitions.
  5. Welcome to Enko!

About the Role

Beast Industries runs mobile experiences at serious scale — across media, mobile gaming, and creator platforms — all generating signals and requests from clients we don't fully trust by default. We're looking for a senior security engineer to own the boundary between our mobile clients and backend services: the systems that determine whether a request, a session, or an account is legitimate.

You'll be the threat-modeling and systems-design owner for device attestation, account integrity, and server-authoritative detection/enforcement against bad actors — fraud rings, bot farms, credential stuffing, and abuse at scale. This is a build-and-lead role: you'll set technical direction, write production code, and grow a team around you.

What You'll Own

  • Device & session integrity — attestation, session enforcement, and authentication hardening across native mobile clients and the backends behind them
  • Abuse & fraud defense — design and run detection/enforcement systems that stay ahead of adversarial, adaptive bad actors operating across our consumer and fintech surfaces
  • Roadmap & strategy — define the multi-quarter security roadmap for account integrity and abuse defense, balancing user trust, growth, and risk
  • Team leadership — lead and grow a team of engineers spanning mobile and backend; set technical bar, review designs, mentor

What We're Looking For

  • 8 to 10+ years in security engineering, with deep experience defending consumer-scale mobile products (hundreds of millions of users/sessions a plus) against account takeover, bot abuse, and fraud
  • Proven ownership of an end-to-end security domain — not just tooling, but the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes
  • Strong systems design instincts: you've built server-authoritative detection pipelines, attestation systems, or similar adversarial-facing infrastructure at scale
  • Hands-on across native mobile (iOS/Android) client internals and the distributed backend services they talk to — you understand both sides of the trust boundary
  • Comfortable operating in Go (or similar) on a major cloud provider (AWS preferred); platform reliability and cost discipline are part of how you think about security, not an afterthought
  • Experience leading engineers (formally or as a tech lead) across disciplines

Why This Role

You'd be one of the first dedicated owners of this space at Beast Industries, with the scope to define how we think about trust, abuse, and integrity across media, fintech, and creator products that reach an enormous, highly engaged audience — and the latitude to build the team and systems from a position of real technical ownership.

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Prenuvo is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Manager (13-month Contract) to step into a full-time interim role while a member of our Finance team is on extended leave. Beyond keeping day-to-day billing operations running smoothly, this role carries a mandate to critically assess and revamp our end-to-end Accounts Receivable process — from invoicing through collections to close — across a multi-entity, multi-currency healthcare organization. You'll be trusted to drive outcomes independently from day one, working closely with Finance, Sales, and Development leadership.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

AR Process Transformation

  • Assess the current end-to-end AR process — invoicing, collections, billing systems, and month-end close — and identify structural gaps, inefficiencies, and risk points
  • Design and implement a revamped AR process, including updated workflows, controls, and documentation that will outlast the interim term

  • Build the case for changes with Finance leadership and drive adoption across the teams the new process touches

  • Lead Finance's side of the Stripe–NetSuite connector project, working directly with Engineering to shape how the two systems are integrated

Collections

What You’ll Bring

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

This role sits close to Federal leadership and works across Domain teams, Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance, and Operations. It is designed for a senior operator who can turn ambiguity into structure, keep important work moving, and help leaders stay focused on customers, pipeline creation, and strategic growth.

The right candidate will bring judgment, follow-through, and the ability to build lightweight systems that improve execution without slowing down a fast-moving Federal business.

Federal Enablement & Operating Cadence

  • Support Federal-specific enablement needs in partnership with Sales Enablement and Sales Operations.

  • Build and maintain operating cadences that help Federal leaders, Domain Directors, Mission Directors, and cross-functional partners stay focused, accountable, and aligned.

Deal Inspection & Pipeline Accountability

  • Inspect priority deals to ensure next steps, risks, owners, pricing, procurement path, and customer alignment are clear.

  • Ask hard questions as opportunities move through stages so deals progress based on strong evidence and clear ownership.
  • Support pipeline health across current-quarter execution and future-quarter creation.
  • Partner with Mission Directors and Domain Directors to identify stuck deals, weak spots, missing artifacts, and areas requiring leadership support.

Strategic Projects & Surge Support

  • Lead or support strategic Federal projects that require focused execution and cross-functional coordination.
  • Provide surge support on priority opportunities where additional senior execution capacity is needed.
  • Support strategic pricing efforts in partnership with Sales, Finance, Product, and Delivery.

  • Strategic projects move faster because a senior operator is driving them to completion.
  • Domain and Mission leaders view this person as a force multiplier, not an added layer of process.

Federal experience is helpful but not required. What matters most is judgment, horsepower, follow-through, and the ability to work across GTM, Product, Sales, Delivery, and Operations.

This person should be comfortable inspecting deals, asking direct questions, tracking details, supporting senior leaders, and jumping into strategic work without needing a perfectly defined lane.   • Able to create structure in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable holding senior teammates accountable in a direct but collaborative way.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

Account Manager – Logistics Operations

About Parsel

Parsel is a logistics and operations platform designed to simplify and optimize supply chain processes. By leveraging technology and customer-focused solutions, Parsel helps streamline order management, customer support, and delivery operations.

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Account Manager – Logistics Operations to oversee carrier and driver relationships, monitor operational performance, and help resolve issues that impact service delivery.

This role goes beyond traditional customer support. While a CX Agent primarily focuses on responding to customer inquiries and resolving individual issues, this position takes a broader, more proactive approach to ensuring smooth day-to-day operations. You’ll work closely with carriers, drivers, and internal teams to identify recurring issues, investigate claims, review operational reports, and address the root causes of problems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, analyzing operational data, taking ownership of complex issues, and driving improvements that strengthen overall operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

Carrier & Driver Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with carriers, drivers, and other logistics partners.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for operational escalations, ensuring issues are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Follow up with carriers and drivers on delivery exceptions, service failures, delays, and other operational concerns.
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across all parties to ensure operational commitments are met.

Operational Performance & Reporting

  • Review operational reports, performance metrics, and delivery data to identify trends, recurring issues, and potential bottlenecks.
  • Monitor carrier and driver performance against service expectations and operational standards.
  • Use data and reporting insights to highlight areas for improvement and support informed decision-making.
  • Maintain accurate records of escalations, investigations, claims, and resolutions.

Root Cause Analysis & Problem-Solving

  • Investigate recurring operational issues and identify their underlying causes rather than focusing only on immediate fixes.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners to implement corrective actions.
  • Proactively identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and risks that could affect service quality or delivery performance.
  • Track issues through resolution and ensure appropriate follow-up to prevent them from recurring.

Claims & Exception Management

  • Investigate shipping claims, lost or damaged shipments, delivery discrepancies, and other logistics-related incidents.
  • Gather relevant documentation, review shipment records, and coordinate with carriers and internal stakeholders to determine what happened.
  • Manage claim follow-ups, support resolution efforts, and ensure cases are documented accurately.
  • Identify patterns in claims and exceptions to recommend improvements to operational processes.

Internal Coordination & Process Improvement

  • Partner with Customer Experience, Operations, and other internal teams to resolve complex cases and maintain operational momentum.
  • Support escalations that require deeper investigation or coordination beyond the scope of a standard CX Agent.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, reporting, and issue-resolution processes.
  • Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures that improve consistency, accountability, and efficiency.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics operations, account management, carrier management, transportation, or a related field.
  • Experience working directly with carriers, drivers, transportation partners, or other external operational stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.
  • Experience reviewing operational reports, tracking KPIs, and using data to identify trends or performance gaps.
  • Exposure to claims management, shipment investigations, delivery exceptions, or logistics escalations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across internal teams and external partners.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple ongoing investigations and follow-ups.
  • A high degree of ownership, accountability, and initiative when resolving operational challenges.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and timely resolutions are important.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in last-mile delivery, freight, shipping, or transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS), shipment tracking platforms, CRM tools, or logistics reporting systems.
  • Experience identifying trends in carrier performance, delivery exceptions, and claims data.
  • Previous experience handling escalations or responsibilities beyond a traditional customer support role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong, reliable working relationships with carriers and drivers.
  • Timely resolution of operational escalations, claims, and delivery exceptions.
  • Improved visibility into carrier performance and recurring operational issues.
  • Clear identification of root causes, with corrective actions that reduce repeat issues.
  • Accurate reporting and documentation that support operational decision-making.
  • Better coordination between CX and Operations, resulting in smoother workflows and stronger service delivery.

Who Would Thrive in This Role?

This role is ideal for someone who has progressed beyond handling individual customer inquiries and is ready to take greater ownership of the operational side of logistics. They should enjoy working with external partners, investigating complex issues, interpreting reports, and finding practical solutions that improve how the business operates.

Talent Acquisition Lead Remote (India) | Full-timeAlso searched as: Talent Acquisition Manager, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Lead - Talent Acquisition, Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition Could you find the candidates India's job boards never show, and close them for a team still taking shape?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Talent Acquisition Lead

Remote (India) | Full-time

Also searched as: Talent Acquisition Manager, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Lead - Talent Acquisition, Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition

Could you find the candidates India's job boards never show, and close them for a team still taking shape?

On a typical day you might pull a stalled search off Naukri in the morning, spend lunch asking a former colleague for an introduction, and tell the hiring lead what changed before they think to ask.

About Contour

Today we operate across three brands with more than 10,000 students and about 500 team members across Australia and India. The India team, which falls under the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building: it runs delivery, automation, people, and operations for the whole organisation.

The GCC is being built now, seat by seat. This one decides how the rest get filled.

About This Role

You lead talent acquisition for Contour's India platform: the hunt, the screen and the close for the openings the business fills in India.

Two things separate a strong hire from a competent one here.

First, a rough brief becomes a real job. The strong recruiter settles the level, writes the skills the way Indian applicants describe them, and sets a package this market will accept, before any outreach.

Second, you close the search the usual routes cannot. The strongest profiles are rarely on job boards, and when direct approaches fail too, the next move is yours: a referral chain, the community where they talk, a fresh pitch to someone who turned us down last month, an agency for one narrow slice. The strong ones choose that route themselves and can name where it worked.

There is no central recruiting desk. You deal directly with the pod leads, the managers who run the squads. This is not a back-office function in a silo: you and the HR Business Partner operate as one, with direction from People and Culture in Australia. The VP of Global Enablement and Support signs off pay and level for every new joiner, and the People team takes over onboarding after the start date. Everything up to and including the handoff is yours.

You lead the recruiters already in place. We want a player-coach who leads by example, not someone who only directs. You can do whatever you delegate, and you will do parts of it yourself, more in some weeks than others, whether that's sourcing, screening or the toughest negotiation. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast.

You are Contour's first dedicated TA lead in India, and you get to write the playbook.

What You Will Do
  • Plan the route for each opening: Agree the quarter's vacancies with pod leads and the VP in advance, then choose the channels, their order, and where a direct approach beats waiting on applications.
  • Grow the pipeline: Headhunt passive candidates on Naukri and LinkedIn Recruiter, build talent pools, and open campus drives from a low base in year one.
  • Hold the bar: Keep one scorecard for all hiring: the same bar in India as everywhere else in Contour.
  • Shape how India sees Contour: Write the careers page, run recruitment marketing, and look after AmbitionBox and Glassdoor.
  • Keep the numbers visible: Look after the ATS and report funnel and diversity data.
  • Manage outside agencies: Decide where one is worth using, agree the terms, and track what each delivers for its fee.
  • Own the process from screening to day one: Set up the screening form, VideoAsk and assessment stages, coach pod leads to interview consistently and fairly, and manage background checks. See every offer through within the agreed band, keep new joiners warm through their notice period, and brief the People team so day one starts with context.
  • Add support as demand grows: Decide when the workload justifies another person, what that addition should be, and hire for it.
  • Coach your recruiters directly: Hold structured 1:1s and performance conversations, and make sure each one knows the bar and why it matters.

If a better channel or tool exists for something you do by hand, make the case and we will back it.

What You Need

We weigh what you have built and run more than the years on your CV. You should be able to point to:

  • Recruiting that was yours: the strategy, the channel and tool choices, and the results, as a lead, a company's sole recruiter, or the person trusted to work from no plan at all.
  • Positions filled across more than one function, with senior hires among them.
  • A vague requirement you took all the way to a signed offer, with the level, titles, skills and package right.
  • Talent pools built from passive profiles, beyond inbound applications.
  • An assessment process you designed, and a shortlist you defended, including a "not this one" that held.
  • A hiring experience applicants spoke well of, or an employer brand you built that brought good profiles to you.
  • Someone you managed directly, such as a recruiter, coordinator or sourcer, with the coaching record to show for it.

Your written English lands with an applicant or a pod lead exactly as intended.

If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy doing the work yourself, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.

Nice to Have
  • EdTech, education or a student-facing background.
  • Experience filling creative, content, operations or automation roles.
  • Zoho Recruit, or a similar ATS.
  • Vendor management.

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on Monday.com. Today we are about 500 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.

The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. The people who do well here care about that and want to know their work made a difference to those students.

They own their work end to end, start things without being asked, and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, including when something is off and what they have already tried, and write decisions down so the next person can pick them up. They give direct feedback and ask for it back.

The pace is fast. Small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle, and whoever spots the problem usually gets to lead the fix. We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own.

We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. Time with us counts, but scope, title and pay move with what you deliver and how much you raise the bar on what you own.

What Good Looks Like
  • Warmer every time: the candidates you reach out to have heard of Contour before you call, because of work you did.
  • Visible, not silent: anyone can see where an opening is up to without asking you.
  • A playbook that compounds: the sources and pitches that worked are written down, so a new vacancy starts from them rather than from zero.

Fully remote, anywhere in India, and comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.

Ready to close the searches the job boards cannot? Apply.

About Tivly
Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.



About the Role
The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. The role aligns priorities across multiple teams into one clear, sequenced plan, sets the standard for what “ready for engineering” means, and makes sure the work being built is the work that matters most. It operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the primary point of accountability for stakeholder alignment across engineering, client services, sales, marketing, and operations, and it drives cross-team decisions to documented outcomes.



What You'll Do

Stakeholder Management & Outcomes
  • Own stakeholder management for the product area: identify key stakeholders, set expectations, manage communication cadence, and be the single point of accountability for alignment. What You'll Do
  • Gather priorities from engineering, client services, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership and reconcile them into one shared, sequenced roadmap
  • Surface conflicting priorities early, put the tradeoffs in front of the right decision-makers, and drive them to a documented resolution
  • Run regular alignment touchpoints (roadmap reviews, priority check-ins, stakeholder updates) so changes in direction are communicated before they become surprises.
  • Manage cross-team dependencies and external partners so that every open item has a named owner, a next step, and a follow-up cadence.
  • Escalate with a clear recommendation when a decision belongs above the team.
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap aligned to company objectives.
  • Lead discovery with client services, sales, and business stakeholders to identify the underlying problems behind requests and validate opportunities before committing to work.


Requirements & Specification
  • Translate business ideas into clear technical requirements — most requests arrive as a business problem, not a deliverable, and it's in this role to determine what's actually needed and who else needs to weigh in.
  • Own backlog health so work arrives at planning well-defined, right-sized, and sequenced against the roadmap.
  • Write and maintain requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases precise enough that engineering can build without re-litigating scope.
  • Partner with engineering on feasibility and technical approach early, and make scope decisions when tradeoffs arise mid-delivery while keeping stakeholders informed of the impact.


Process & Standards
  • Define and evolve how intake, refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder acceptance work for the team, adjusting as team size, cadence, and product needs change.
  • Partner with engineering to maintain accurate documentation and decision records so past decisions remain traceable.
  • Identify recurring friction in how work moves between teams and drive fixes rather than workarounds.



What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, CRM, lead generation, or insurance/fintech.
  • Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.
  • Track record of owning a product area’s roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to run backlog refinement and sprint planning, and to improve those processes with engineering teams.
  • Experience working with client-facing teams and external partners on integration or feature requests.
  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy conversations into clean, unambiguous requirements and concise leadership updates.
  • Proficiency with Jira or a comparable tool, and comfort using data to inform decisions.
  • Comfortable pushing back on engineering, stakeholders, and leadership when scope, requirements, or priorities are not sound.

​


Core Competencies

  • Stakeholder Management: Owns stakeholder relationships end to end, sets and manages expectations proactively, and keeps the right people informed at the right level of detail.
  • Multi-Team Alignment: Reconciles competing priorities across teams into a single plan, makes the tradeoffs visible, and drives decisions to a documented outcome.
  • Outcome Ownership: Defines what success looks like, measures against it, and connects day-to-day prioritization to business results.
  • Requirements & Solution Design: Turns ambiguous business problems into clear, testable, well-scoped solutions, including edge cases and acceptance criteria.
  • Prioritization & Tradeoff Management: Balances client requests, technical debt, compliance, and roadmap commitments, and makes tradeoffs explicit and defensible.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Gives honest, specific status (“not yet, here’s what’s outstanding”) rather than guessed timelines, and adjusts the message for leadership, peers, and partners.
  • Process Ownership: Has the judgment to shape intake, refinement, planning, and acceptance to fit the team, and to change them as the team and product evolve.
  • Partnership Over Transaction: Works with engineering as a peer, collaborating by default but willing to hold a firm line on scope and quality.


Travel
  • Infrequent travel (up to 5%) for occasional team on-site gatherings.



Compensation
  • Base salary up to $150,000 annually, plus quarterly bonus potential based on achievement of quarterly goals.



Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Sick Time
  • Flexible Scheduling (Flex Time)

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Alpaca's product team is looking for a Product Manager to help drive Alpaca's tokenization surface - centered on the Instant Tokenization Network (ITN) and the issuer, authorized participant, market maker, and broker experiences built on top of it.

You will partner deeply with engineering, compliance, legal, operations, partnerships, and the broader Alpaca product team to ship regulated tokenization infrastructure at scale. You will be expected to provide early signal on tokenized securities and RWA policy developments rather than react after rules formalize.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Drive the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for Alpaca’s tokenization surface - centered on the Instant Tokenization Network (ITN) and adjacent issuer / AP / broker experiences.
  • Own flagship initiatives end-to-end - including mint and redeem flows, settlement and custody decisions, and on-chain issuance for partners
  • Prioritize ruthlessly across partner demand, regulatory constraints, engineering capacity, and commercial upside - with clear yes / no / not now framing.
  • Lead build-vs-buy, partner-vs-direct, and onshore-vs-offshore tradeoffs across tokenization infrastructure

Partnerships & Growth

  • Run discovery with issuers, authorized participants / market makers, broker-dealers, exchanges, custodians, and institutional clients integrating Alpaca’s tokenization rails.
  • Own the AP and issuer experience - documentation, sandbox parity, onboarding workflows, exception handling, and the operational loops
  • Translate partner needs into sequenced product decisions without over-promising; represent tokenization credibly in partner conversations alongside BD and Sales.
  • Shape broker enablement (APIs, SDKs, docs, reference integrations) so broker partners and fintechs can access tokenized equities

Regulatory & Policy

  • Partner with Legal and Compliance on transfer-agent, broker-dealer, custody, AML, and tokenized-securities frameworks; land regulatory requirements cleanly into product and ops design.
  • Surface early signal on policy and competitive moves in tokenized securities / RWA - feed them into the Digital Assets roadmap before rules or rivals force a scramble.
  • Align Engineering, Ops, Finance, Risk, BD, and leadership behind a single tokenization roadmap; escalate tradeoffs early and unblock the team.

Who You Are (Must Haves):

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and ready to own one of the company’s most strategically important Digital Assets surfaces.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 6+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, and/or starting a startup, with senior-level ownership in tokenization, digital assets, brokerage, exchanges, market infrastructure, or capital-markets technology.
  • Demonstrated ownership of tokenized securities, RWA issuance, on-chain settlement, or closely related regulated digital-asset products at production (or near-production institutional) scale.
  • Strong understanding of equity / capital-markets market structure - trading, custody, clearing/settlement, stock loan / borrow, and post-trade operations - and how those workflows map onto blockchain rails.
  • Experience shipping in a regulated environment alongside Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Operations - comfortable with ambiguity and real-time tradeoffs, not waiting for perfect alignment.
  • Proven ability to run partner / customer discovery and turn it into a prioritized roadmap; excellent written and verbal communication across engineering and executive audiences.
  • Business acumen to weigh ROI, partner demand, regulatory risk, tech feasibility, time, and budget.
  • AI-native PM workflow; AI is part of your daily stack in getting work done.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Direct experience at a broker-dealer, exchange, transfer agent, custodian, market maker, or institutional digital-asset / RWA platform.
  • Experience with tokenized money market funds, tokenized securities, RWA issuance, or other regulated tokenized-asset products.
  • Prior work on RFQ, atomic settlement flows
  • Background combining regulated financial product context (broker-dealer, exchange, custodian) with crypto-native infrastructure.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Operations Manager to join our Provider Core Ops, Systems Implementation (PCOSI) team to lead Product Implementation. In this role, you will manage the product implementation team, driving the operational execution, change management, and launch strategy for product features that impact Lyra’s full provider network and client base.

You will serve as the essential bridge translating clinical standards, service line goals and business growth targets into seamless product rollouts. You will manage a high-performing team and partner directly with Product, Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Service Line leaders. As our product surface area expands across complex program offerings and multi-channel launches,, you will evolve our implementation playbooks, resolve cross-functional roadblocks early, and ensure every product enhancement lands with high quality and operational integrity.

Core Focus Areas

  • Team Leadership & Inward Management: Direct, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of Product Implementation leads and senior individual contributors.

  • Playbook Evolution & Scale: Evolve legacy launch playbooks into sophisticated, repeatable frameworks built to handle exponentially increasing product complexity and rapid multi-channel rollouts.

  • Outward Influence & Strategic Alignment: Drive cross-functional alignment across senior stakeholders in Tech, Product, Clinical, and Business teams to resolve competing priorities and clear execution roadblocks.

Responsibilities:

  • People Management & Team Leadership: Serve as direct people manager to the Product Implementation pillar within Provider Core Ops. Develop tactical team plans, delegate effectively, and invest in team culture, performance, and career development.

  • End-to-End Product Implementation: Own the operational strategy and execution of product and policy changes across the full product lifecycle. Ensure internal provider and external client/partner audiences are enabled for success.

  • Cross-Functional Strategic Unblocking: Act as the primary operational liaison to Product, Tech, and Clinical leadership. Poke holes early in product development, surface risk, reconcile program goals with macro business goals, and align competing stakeholder priorities.

  • Playbook Development & Continuous Improvement: Evolve and maintain standardized product development and launch playbooks to support rapid platform growth across diverse service lines and provider network structures.

  • Systems & Product Synergy: Work in tandem with the Systems Architecture pillar to ensure user-facing product features map seamlessly to underlying data infrastructure.

  • Change Management & Strategic Communications: Oversee implementation comms and enablement strategies to ensure providers and clinical ops teams navigate platform shifts smoothly and feel supported in delivering care.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in Product Operations, Clinical Operations, Program Management, Business Operations, or a related high-growth digital health/healthcare function.

  • People Leadership: Proven track record as a direct people manager with demonstrated success setting operational roadmaps, delegating effectively, managing senior ICs, and mentoring team members.

  • Product & Systems Acumen: Deep experience navigating the software development lifecycle, product rollouts, and tech stacks (Salesforce, EHR, Zendesk, Asana, Jira).

  • Healthcare & Clinical Context: Direct experience working closely with clinicians, care providers, or clinical leadership in a healthcare or digital health setting; deep understanding of how to balance clinical workflows with product growth goals.

  • Strategic Communication & XFN Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to storytell, manage senior executive/XFN stakeholders, and negotiate competing priorities across departments.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a Law Enforcement Liaison and Blockchain Investigator, you will have a crucial role in connecting advanced blockchain technology with the efforts of law enforcement. Your expertise in blockchain analytics will be vital in decrypting complex virtual currency transactions, assisting in the discovery and prevention of financial crimes. This position requires a unique combination of technical knowledge, analytical skills, and a profound understanding of the blockchain ecosystem.

Your role will require more than just analyzing data. You will also be responsible for converting complicated blockchain data into practical intelligence for law enforcement agencies. To stay ahead of the latest trends in virtual currencies and blockchain technology, you must take a proactive approach. This will ensure that our strategies and tools are always at the forefront of the industry.

As part of this job, you will be responsible for detecting potentially illegal activities such as money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes within blockchain networks. Your efforts will assist law enforcement agencies in their investigations and will be crucial in shaping the future of virtual currency security measures. Your work will have a direct impact on public safety and legal enforcement.

In this role, you will be working in a collaborative environment where you will interact with different stakeholders such as law enforcement officers, cybersecurity experts, legal professionals, and management. This position provides a unique opportunity to make a significant impact in the fast-changing world of blockchain technology while adhering to the highest standards of legal and ethical compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ state-of-the-art blockchain analytics tools to analyze virtual currency transactions. This includes tracing transaction histories, identifying patterns, and uncovering illicit activities within blockchain networks.

  • Act as a primary point of contact for law enforcement agencies. Provide detailed, understandable reports and insights on blockchain activities to assist in criminal investigations.

  • Efficiently respond to and action incoming requests from law enforcement. This involves gathering relevant data, conducting thorough analyses, and delivering timely and accurate information.

  • Enhancing law enforcement's understanding of patterns and indicators of illicit activity on the blockchain.

  • Stay abreast of the latest developments in blockchain technology, virtual currency trends, and regulatory changes. Apply this knowledge to enhance analytical methods and tools.

  • Interdepartmental Coordination: Work closely with other departments, such as legal and compliance, to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and company policies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Criminal, Business Management, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Proven experience with blockchain analytics, preferably Chainalysis, TRM Labs or Elliptic.

  • Deep and proven understanding of cryptocurrency transaction patterns and potential indicators of criminal activity.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into understandable terms for law enforcement personnel.

  • Experience working with law enforcement agencies is highly desirable.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
