jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
The Mission

A beautifully designed slot machine is completely useless if the underlying math engine doesn't grip the player. We aren't looking for an isolated academic or a passive spreadsheet clerk who just calculates basic probabilities. We need a "Volatility Architect" to design the mathematical heart of our iGaming ecosystem. Your job is to engineer the exact numerical frameworks—the hitting frequencies, cascading bonus loops, and risk profiles—that generate psychological suspense and thrill players with surgical precision. This is a remote, high-availability role for a math mastermind who can transform raw numbers into pure, unadulterated excitement.

We value predictive logic, algorithmic creativity, and a killer product instinct over standard corporate pedigrees. You will step directly into an elite, multi-disciplinary engine room, collaborating closely with slot developers, digital artists, kinetic animators, and product owners to deliver the most thrilling casino games on the market. If you are an exceptional, high-vibe individual with spectacular analytical depth, a passion for data-driven iteration, and the drive to code your models into reality, we will give you the ultimate playground to build your legacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Math Model Engineering: Design, simulate, and calibrate advanced mathematical models for slots and iGaming titles, balancing RTP (Return to Player) targets with compelling gameplay mechanics.

  • Java Logic Implementation: Write clean, efficient, and robust Java code to build out math engines, game logic components, and high-fidelity simulation frameworks.

  • Full-Spectrum Collaboration: Partner deeply as an integral core team member alongside graphics artists, sound designers, backend devs, and product managers to ensure the math translates perfectly into audio-visual rhythm.

  • Massive Simulation Runs: Execute trillions of simulated game rounds to stress-test your models, ensuring theoretical payout distributions perfectly align with absolute regulatory compliance.

  • Performance Analytics: Dissect live game metrics, revenue models, and player spin telemetry with cold, analytical rigor, using real-world data to sharpen the math for our next breakout title.

  • Documentation & Verification: Author crystal-clear mathematical specification documents and paytables, handling the technical compliance loops required to clear external testing laboratories.

The Requirements

  • The "Math Mastermind": A world-class analytical mind with spectacular mastery of probability theory, combinatorics, and statistical modeling. You look at numbers and see human behavior.

  • Java Mastery: Robust, hands-on experience writing and deploying clean code in Java. You don't just calculate theoretical models on paper; you possess the technical skill to build your own simulation environments.

  • The Gamer's Intuition: A profound, innate understanding of what makes an iGaming title exciting, volatile, and deeply retentive. You know exactly how a near-miss or a staggered bonus multiplier feels to a player.

  • Hyper-Availability: This isn't a slow-moving academic office. The global iGaming market operates 24/7/365, and production loops move fast. You must be available 7 days a week to handle real-time simulation pivots, launch validations, and urgent math revisions.

  • Operational Autonomy: A great teammate who brings infectious energy, zero ego, and a relentless focus on execution. You can manage complex statistical projects from your laptop without any hand-holding.

Operational Details

  • Location: Fully Remote.

  • Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to align with real-time launch windows, data sprints, and global engineering timelines).

  • Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just a data-science desk; we offer the chance to anchor the revenue engine of an aggressive global powerhouse.

  • Absolute Strategic Sovereignty: We value raw output and technical innovation over corporate red tape. If your math models pass simulations and drive player retention, we push them live.

  • Global Infrastructure: Your code and logic will instantly step onto a worldwide stage, driving the core entertainment loops for thousands of active players every single second.

  • A Culture of Pure Momentum: Join an elite squad that moves at lightspeed. You will be constantly building, testing fresh payout paradigms, and seeing your technical execution hit production in real time.

  • High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Game Mathematician who consistently engineers highly commercial, top-tier math engines, there is a clear, unrestricted runway to lead our entire gaming architecture and analytics ecosystem.

¡Multiplica Talent, te está buscando!

Multiplica Talent Perú, consultora especializada en buscar y contratar al mejor talento digital para formar parte de proyectos retadores y transformar la experiencia de los usuarios desde el conocimiento profundo de nuestros clientes del sector banca y seguros, asegurando resultados extraordinarios.

Estamos buscando profesionales en todo Perú y México con el rol de UX DESIGNER que tengan +3 años de experiencia para trabajar con nuestro cliente del rubro seguro por un proyecto de 3 meses en modalidad remoto.

Nos interesa que puedas entender los objetivos a alcanzar del negocio, con bases sólidas en diseño e interacción, orientado siempre al usuario final. Será importante que tengas buenas habilidades de observación, empatía, escucha activa y comunicación para que puedas fundamentar bien tus propuestas.

Nuestro UX Designer, de acuerdo a su categorización, tendrá funciones como:

  • Entendimiento estratégico de las especificaciones de productos.
  • Asegurarse del mantenimiento de una buena experiencia de usuario de todos los productos y/o servicios en todas las plataformas de acuerdo con las mejores prácticas.
  • Facilitar las sesiones de co-creación
  • Estructurar y presentar resultados de metodologías de diseño centrado en el usuario (entrevistas con stakeholders, sesiones brainstorm, workshops, testeos y evaluaciones, etc.)
  • Colaborar con diseñadores de experiencia de usuario, de interfaz, desarrolladores y managers de producto.
  • Desarrollar prototipos y wireframes alrededor de las necesidades de usuario y negocio para usarlos como herramienta de testeo.
  • Poder formular KPIs y métricas con base en datos obtenidos de una investigación previa.
  • Uso de fuentes secundarias de información tales como web analytics, reportes de servicio al cliente, encuestas, etc. para obtener conclusiones de comportamiento de usuario.

Conocimiento y habilidades técnicas:

  • Conocimientos sólidos en distintas metodologías de datos cualitativos y cuantitativos con el fin de analizar la información para obtener insights.
  • Bajar insights de investigación a decisiones de diseño.
  • Capaz de crear reportes accionables cuyas conclusiones traduzcan claramente los hallazgos de la investigación y que puedan convertirse en soluciones tangibles.
  • Experiencia trabajando con software de prototipado, wireframes en alta fidelidad (Sketch,Figma, UXPin, Axure, InVision, Principle, Marvel, etc.)
  • Realizar pruebas de usabilidad.
  • Experiencia en metodología de Diseño Centrado en el Usuario.
  • Realizar el inventariado de contenidos, definición de AI (arquitectura de información) y flujos de navegación a partir de los hallazgos obtenidos en las pruebas cualitativas y cuantitativas.
  • Elaboración de partituras de interacción.
  • Conocimiento y aplicación de Design Thinking, Design System, Atomic Design y otros.

Conocimiento y habilidades técnicas flexibles:

  • Conocimiento de herramientas de maquetación tales como HTML5, CSS3.
  • Experiencia en la participación de proyectos de service design, elaborando el viaje del usuario y service blueprint.
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinarios ágiles.
  • Mentoría y capacitación a otros diseñadores.
Beneficios:
  • Participar en proyectos desafiantes, con importantes clientes.
  • Salario competitivo
  • Contrato en planilla con todos los beneficios de Ley
  • Capacitación constante

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross-functional automation.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
  • Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
  • Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
  • Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts.
  • Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
  • Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
  • Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem.
  • Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
  • Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
  • Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
  • Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

  • Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions.

City: Remote

State: Remote

Job Summary

Reviews Environmental Site Assessment (ESA), Property Condition Assessment (PCA), Property Condition Equity (PCE), and/or Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) reports and/or Seismic Reports (including Seismic Risk Assessments, Tier 1 Reports, and Structural Building Systems Assessments. Communicates with the field staff and provides feedback on quality of written report. Helps instruct the field staff and provides “redlined” versions of reports to field staff when the submitted report requires changes or improvements that should have been completed by the field staff. Monitors, prioritizes, and tracks work progress while providing quality control reviews and technical editing of reports generated. Provides direct data to the team and is knowledgeable about client protocols.

Core Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Reviews, writes, and technically edits reports to ensure 100% accuracy, completeness, and quality. Prepares report for on-time delivery to client with accompanying correspondence. Ensures that reports are reviewed and submitted to client delivery in advance of the due to client date.
  2. Upholds industry and company standards by providing guidance on technical issues.
  3. Responsible for escalation regarding quality of reports and issues that should be brought to a client’s attention in advance of the client receiving the report. Authorizes shipment/transmittal of completed reports to client.
  4. Reviews and makes changes as necessary to assigned project reports, including completing the cross checks for projects. Reviews, provides feedback, and evaluates field staff work and progress and identifies and resolves problems in reports.
  5. Provides technical direction and guidance to field staff. Provides “redlined” versions of reports to field assessors when the report submitted requires changes or improvements that should have been completed by the field staff. Participates in providing quality data to field staff to identify the improvements necessary for their reports so that field staff performance in report writing and data collection continues to improve.
  6. Actively participates in portfolios including review of reports for portfolio properties, assisting in creating protocols and participates in development of protocol checklists.

  8. On occasion, will be required to meet the job requirements and perform the duties of the onsite Project Assessor (field).

  11. Protects operations by keeping company information confidential.
  12. Delivers outstanding customer service through timely response and proactive solutions to clients’ needs.
  13. Demonstrates BV’s guiding principles in support of the company's strategic goals.
  14. Follows all documented policies, Standard Operating Procedures, and Work Instructions applicable to the position and support of BV's quality standards and strategic initiatives.
  15. Maintains safe and clean work area by complying with all procedures, rules, and regulations.
  16. May be responsible for managing as the lead of other Technical Report Reviewers.
  17. May be responsible for managing vendors and subcontractors.
  18. Must be able to meet the physical demands of the job.

Role Specific Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Responsibilities include serving as technical reviewer for Transactional HUD reports, including but not limited to reviews of: Property Condition Assessments, Phase I Environmental Site Assessments, asbestos/lead/radon sampling, seismic reports, structural surveys, roofing surveys, ADA checklists, pre-construction document reviews, construction monitoring, and other property related services.

  3. Extensive experience with HUD MAP and HUD LEAN needed.
  4. Familiarity with HUD Etool needed.
  5. Extensive ADA, FHA and 504/UFAs knowledge required.

May indirectly or directly supervise employees on the team. May carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. May have responsibilities including training employees, planning, assigning, and directing work.

Skills

  • Language Ability: Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and standard operating procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, peers, and technical field staff.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Technology Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be proficient in operating a computer, having knowledge of word processing software, spreadsheet software, and project management software. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to operate an electronic tablet in the field for live data collection.

Competencies

  • Active listening skills
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Problem solving skills
  • Oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to motivate, develop, and direct people
  • Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment.
  • Ability to work in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Must have a cell phone and supply your own internet service.

Education, Certifications, and Experience

Education and/or Experience:

Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university in related field; minimum of five years of related experience. In lieu of degree, eight years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Valid driver's license required with no significant MVA points/violations (clean driving record).
  • Employees who incur $2,000 or more per year in company-related travel expenses will be required to obtain a Corporate Credit Card. Employees who incur less than $2,000 per year in company-related travel expenses will be required to have sufficient personal credit to cover their business travel costs.

Physical and Environmental Conditions

While performing the office/offsite duties of this job, the employee is required to:

  • Operate a computer (up to 100% of workweek)
  • Regularly required to use hands.
  • Repetitive use of hands/fingers for keyboard interaction (frequently)
  • Talk and hear
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear.
  • Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The noise level in the home or company office environment is usually quiet.
  • Ability to successfully work from remote location.

While performing the onsite/field duties of the Project Assessor (field), the employee is required to:

  • Walk (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)
  • Stand (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)

  • Climb and balance Stairs (at least once for each building assessed)

  • Ability to successfully work from remote location.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Business Development Manager – Thermal Rolls & Shipping Labels

B2B Wholesale, Reseller and Distributor Sales

Location: Remote / Work From Home
Employment Type: Full-Time
Market: Australia
Industry: Thermal Paper Rolls | Direct Thermal Labels | Packaging Supplies | POS Consumables | Office Supplies

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager / Senior Account Manager to drive B2B sales of thermal paper rolls, direct thermal shipping labels and related consumable products across Australia.

The role is focused on developing high-volume commercial accounts through:

  • Wholesalers
  • Distributors
  • Resellers
  • Office supply dealers
  • Packaging suppliers
  • POS equipment suppliers
  • Cash register suppliers
  • Stationery distributors
  • E-commerce supply companies
  • Logistics and fulfilment suppliers
  • Buying groups
  • Retail chains
  • National account customers

This is a sales and revenue-focused position. The successful candidate must have an established understanding of the Australian B2B reseller, wholesale and distribution market.

A minimum of five years' Australian B2B sales experience is mandatory.

Products

The product range may include:

  • EFTPOS thermal paper rolls
  • POS and cash register rolls
  • Receipt paper rolls
  • BPA-free and phenol-free thermal rolls
  • Direct thermal shipping labels
  • 100 mm × 150 mm courier labels
  • Barcode labels
  • Freight and logistics labels
  • Printer-compatible label rolls
  • Custom-sized thermal labels
  • Packaging and warehouse consumables
  • Private-label and OEM product ranges

Key Responsibilities

Business Development

  • Identify and secure new reseller, wholesale and distributor accounts across Australia.
  • Build a strong sales pipeline of high-volume commercial buyers.
  • Target office supply dealers, packaging distributors, POS suppliers, logistics suppliers and national buying groups.
  • Generate new business through outbound calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, trade databases and industry networks.
  • Present pricing, product specifications and commercial supply proposals to decision-makers.
  • Negotiate reseller pricing, wholesale agreements, volume discounts and supply contracts.
  • Convert prospects into active, repeat-purchase customers.
  • Develop state-based and national distribution opportunities.
  • Identify private-label, exclusive distribution and high-volume contract opportunities.

Account Management

  • Manage and grow existing reseller, wholesale and distributor accounts.
  • Maintain strong relationships with business owners, procurement managers, category managers and sales managers.
  • Increase customer order frequency, average order value and product range penetration.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling.
  • Prepare account-specific pricing and volume rebate structures.
  • Resolve customer issues commercially and maintain high account-retention levels.
  • Reactivate dormant and underperforming accounts.
  • Monitor competitor pricing and protect account profitability.

Sales Strategy

  • Develop and execute a national B2B sales plan.
  • Segment the market by reseller type, purchasing volume, location and commercial opportunity.
  • Recommend pricing structures for carton, pallet and container-level quantities.
  • Analyse competitor products, pricing, specifications and market positioning.
  • Identify gaps in the Australian thermal roll and shipping-label market.
  • Support the development of distributor programs, reseller incentives and sales promotions.
  • Provide accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting.
  • Work closely with operations, purchasing and management to align stock availability with sales demand.

Product and Commercial Support

  • Understand and confidently communicate product specifications, including:
    • Label dimensions
    • Labels per roll
    • Core diameter
    • Roll diameter
    • Paper quality
    • Thermal coating
    • Adhesive type
    • Perforation
    • Printer compatibility
    • BPA-free and phenol-free requirements
    • FSC or other applicable environmental certifications
    • Carton quantities
    • Pallet configurations
    • Custom manufacturing options
  • Prepare quotations, tenders, pricing schedules and reseller proposals.
  • Coordinate product samples and customer trials.
  • Assist customers with product selection and compatibility requirements.
  • Support onboarding of new reseller and distribution accounts.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, follow-up activities and sales notes.

Mandatory Experience

Applicants must have:

  • A minimum of five years' B2B sales experience in the Australian market.
  • Proven experience selling to Australian wholesalers, distributors, resellers or buying groups.
  • Strong experience managing commercial accounts and developing repeat-order business.
  • Demonstrated success generating new accounts through outbound business development.
  • Experience negotiating wholesale pricing and high-volume supply agreements.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian B2B sales processes and buyer expectations.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong commercial negotiation and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and online sales tools.
  • The ability to work independently and remain accountable to sales targets.

Highly Desirable Industry Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

  • Thermal paper rolls
  • Direct thermal labels
  • Shipping and courier labels
  • POS consumables
  • Cash register supplies
  • Packaging products
  • Barcode and identification products
  • Office supplies
  • Stationery wholesale

Candidates with existing relationships across Australian reseller, wholesale, office supply, packaging or POS distribution channels will be highly regarded.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a commercially aggressive and highly accountable B2B sales professional who understands how to build revenue through reseller and distribution channels.

You will be comfortable:

  • Cold calling prospective accounts
  • Opening new reseller relationships
  • Speaking directly with business owners and procurement managers
  • Comparing competitor pricing
  • Negotiating volume-based supply agreements
  • Managing long B2B sales cycles
  • Following up consistently
  • Closing high-volume accounts
  • Growing repeat monthly and quarterly orders

This is not a customer service or general administration role. It is a hands-on business development position focused on winning accounts, increasing sales and building long-term distribution channels.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against:

  • New reseller and distributor accounts opened
  • Qualified opportunities generated
  • Monthly and quarterly sales revenue
  • Gross profit generated
  • Number of outbound sales activities
  • Quotation-to-order conversion rate
  • Repeat-order rate
  • Average account value
  • Customer retention

What Success Looks Like

Within the first three to six months, the successful candidate will have:

  • Developed a qualified national sales pipeline

  • Established relationships with key industry decision-makers
  • Secured recurring carton and pallet-volume orders

Application Requirements

Applicants must provide:

Applications without at least five years of relevant Australian B2B sales experience will not be considered.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, govern, and scale their AI applications with speed and intelligence. Kong's AI Management solution – including our flagship AI Gateway – is one of our most strategic and fastest-growing product areas, and we're growing the team to match.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the AI Management product team, based in our Milan office. You'll be the product owner for some of our most exciting, fastest-growing agentic AI management and infrastructure products.

You'll work in close partnership with the broader AI Management research & development team, with a focus on driving definition and delivery of features and cross-team product work, collaborating with product managers and engineers around the world, while also supporting the field activities, including product marketing, sales, and enablement. This is a high-impact, hands-on product management role that reports directly to our Director & Head of AI Products.

What You’ll Do:

  • AI Management Product Modules: Own the product direction for AI Management product modules that help connect, govern, supervise, and optimize agentic AI, including models, context, agentic harnesses, guardrails, evaluation, policies, and more. You'll define requirements, write specs, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery of your module’s features in close collaboration with engineering.

You'll navigate shared roadmaps, negotiate priorities across teams, and ensure AI Gateway's infrastructure needs aren't blocked by cross-team complexity.

  • Roadmap & Delivery: Own a clearly defined product roadmap for your areas, balancing new feature development against technical debt, infrastructure work, and platform dependencies. You'll partner with engineering leads to scope work, make trade-off decisions, and maintain a reliable delivery cadence.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. jobs.excerpt: About Offshore Launch:Offshore Launch is a business and growth operations firm helping home service owners scale their operations.
jobs.description:
About Offshore Launch:

Offshore Launch is a business and growth operations firm helping home service owners scale their operations.

We design, build, and staff business and revenue operations so the shop runs on clear process, technology and data - so owners can work on the business instead of being trapped inside it.

We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every employee and client in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

  • Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.
  • Work in a people-first, remote environment that values career growth.
  • Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, transparent bonus, raise and career pathways - with an overall emphasis on teamwork, collaboration, and work/life balance.
  • Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Who We Serve

We serve family-owned and owner-operated home service businesses (plumbing, HVAC, and other trades) that run on FieldPulse, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, and similar field service platforms. We give them the operational infrastructure and talent to run day-to-day operations, so the owners can focus on the field, sales, and growth.

About the Role

You’ll be the remote office manager for a family-owned plumbing company in the US. The owners need one person who runs the office end to end. That means answering every customer call and text, owning the dispatch board, and closing out jobs. At the end of each day, you tell them what was sold, what was collected, and what’s scheduled next.

By your 90th day, you’re the administrative backbone of the business. The owners trust the board because you run it. Plumbers send schedule changes through you instead of moving jobs themselves.

What You’ll Own

  • Call intake and customer communication: Answer every incoming call, text, and Google Local Services lead from one shared inbox. Enter each one in the field service software the same day, tagged with its lead source. Give customers arrival windows, leave pricing to the plumbers, and call back when you said you would.
  • Scheduling and dispatch: Own the dispatch board as the single source of truth. Book arrival windows and assign plumbers, helpers, and equipment (excavator, hydro jetter). Handle every reschedule.
  • Job tracking and return visits: Review every open job’s status daily, from booking through completion and invoicing. Make sure plumbers post status updates and notes. Book return trips on the original job, and flag jobs at risk of slipping.
  • Estimate follow-up: Review open estimates every morning and confirm whether the office or the plumber follows up. Update the status after each touch, and close out estimates that go cold.
  • Job closeout and payments: Each morning, check yesterday’s paid invoices for job costs, the correct commission rate, fees, referral tags, and deposits. Flag anything that doesn’t add up.
  • Payroll and time tracking support: Verify plumber commissions and helper hours each pay cycle, and chase missing clock-ins before payroll runs.
  • Permits and compliance: Track every job that needs a permit. Send certificates of insurance (COIs) to cities that require them before the work is scheduled.
  • Daily reporting: Send the owner an end-of-day summary every business day covering what was sold, what was collected, and what’s on tomorrow’s board.
  • Process documentation: Turn every recurring task into a simple written process so the office runs the same way every day.

How Success Is Measured

  • 95% of calls answered, with under 5 minutes to respond to new leads
  • 75%+ of qualified leads booked
  • Every lead entered the same day with its lead source
  • A dispatch board that matches reality at the end of every day
  • Open estimates followed up every day, per the follow-up process
  • Paid invoices checked every morning, with deposits collected on scheduled work
  • Hours and commissions verified before every pay run
  • Permits and COIs sent before the job is scheduled
  • End-of-day summary sent every business day

What You Bring

Must have:

  • 2+ years as an office manager, dispatcher, customer service rep (CSR), or operations coordinator, ideally for a plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or other field service company
  • Experience answering customer calls and texts as a core part of your job
  • Experience owning a schedule or dispatch board for a team working in the field
  • Hands-on experience with at least one field service platform: FieldPulse, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Workiz, or similar
  • Clear, confident written and spoken English for US homeowners on the phone
  • A reliable remote setup: stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup plan for outages

Nice to have:

  • Direct plumbing or HVAC experience
  • QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Time
  • Podium or another customer messaging inbox
  • Experience checking commissions or hours before payroll
  • Experience handling permits or certificates of insurance
  • Basic job costing familiarity

How You Work

  • Detail first: Tags, rates, fees, and notes are right the first time.
  • You own it to the end: Every call, job, and estimate goes from first contact to close without the owner stepping in.
  • You bring solutions: When something breaks, you raise it early with the problem, three options, and your recommendation.
  • You write it down: Recurring work becomes a documented process.
  • You live in the system: Every customer conversation is logged on the job, not in side texts.

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch):

  • Up to $1600/mo depending on experience
  • Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary
  • Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.
  • 16 days PTO

Note:

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

Career Category

Corporate Services

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

You'll turn the expertise of our leadership and subject-matter experts into clear, credible materials for founders, investors, family offices, and partners. Then you'll get those materials into the right hands, across our website, social channels, and partner networks, and keep them current.

This is a big role, and we know it. It's built as a stretch opportunity for someone early in their career who wants real ownership quickly, with direct mentorship from our VP of Brand & Partnerships and visibility with our CEO. You won't be doing it alone: you'll have design and development partners, contractor support, and leadership invested in your growth.

You'll own important work from your first weeks. You'll work closely with designers rather than produce every asset yourself, but you'll need a strong visual eye and a willingness to jump in when a layout needs help.

What success looks like

You'll also have a content plan for the new website, including what gets rewritten, migrated, or retired.

By six months, the new FinStrat website will be live with your copy and content migration behind it. Our refreshed positioning will show up consistently across the site, sales materials, social, and partner channels, and you'll be using engagement data and team feedback to decide what to make next.

What you'll do

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
