Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword — it's a way of life. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Qualified is the B2B agentic marketing platform for Salesforce customers, and we're looking for a Sr. Manager of Product Marketing to help us win in one of the most exciting and fast-moving moments in company history. Qualified is part of AI Labs, Salesforce's new innovation team built to develop and scale AI-native technologies at startup speed — leveraging the full power of Salesforce. Alongside sister companies like Fin and Regrello, Qualified operates with the agility of a startup, while plugging into one of the world's largest enterprise go-to-market engines, bringing the agentic enterprise vision to life for Salesforce's customers.

With our product, Piper the #1 SDR Agent, now an official part of the Salesforce family, we need a sharp, versatile PMM who can do it all, from supporting product launches, to delivering our message at events, to sharpening our cross-cloud positioning. This is a true jack-of-all-trades role. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing, and your work will directly impact how thousands of Salesforce sellers understand and sell Qualified.

What You'll Do

  • Support product marketing leadership in defining the relationship between Qualified, Piper and the broader Salesforce ecosystem — clearly answering the questions that come up daily in the field
  • Develop enterprise-ready positioning assets that address long-term roadmap, architectural relationships, and integration vision (Data Cloud, MCP, Service Cloud, Agentforce Agents etc.)
  • Become a strong expert on competitive positioning within the Salesforce ecosystem, with a strong POV on how Qualified wins better together with Salesforce's own solutions
  • Collaborate with cross-product marketing and GTM leadership to keep positioning sharp as the product and integration story evolves
  • Drive cross-cloud positioning enablement programs in partnership with Sales Enablement, Sales Leadership, and Product Marketing
  • Lead product marketing workstreams for flagship events (e.g., Dreamforce), coordinating slides, demos, production, and legal review across session content
  • Partner with onsite staff and demo teams to ensure consistent narrative and positioning at every touchpoint
  • Drive post-event enablement follow-through, translating event narrative into lasting field-ready assets
  • Support go-to-market planning and execution for Piper product releases — from positioning through launch readiness, timing, and cross-functional rollout
  • Partner with Product and Product Management to translate roadmap into clear, sellable launch narratives and timelines
  • Build and run launch tiering frameworks, aligning scope and investment to the size and impact of each release


What We're Looking For

  • 5–8 years of product marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS; experience at a Salesforce ISV or within the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus
  • Proven track record driving success in a role that spans product positioning & messaging or sales enablement
  • Deep familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem (Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or similar) and comfort navigating technical positioning, especially with AI agents
  • Strong written communicator who can translate complex concepts into crisp narratives for sellers, customers, and executive audiences
  • Background in competitive intelligence / competitive strategy a plus
  • Highly collaborative — you'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Sales Programs, Product, Success, Demand Gen, and Product on a daily basis
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, post-acquisition environment with shifting priorities and lots of ambiguity


Why Qualified

  • You'll be part of a company that just joined the Salesforce family — with the distribution and resources of one of the world's leading enterprise tech companies behind us
  • You'll have outsized impact on a small, high-output PMM team that punches way above its weight
  • Competitive compensation, equity, benefits, and the chance to work alongside some of the best GTM minds in the industry

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. About Us

Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.

The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

Who are we?

At Qualio, the engineering department is responsible for the "what" and the "how". "What" as in what should we build for our customers. "How" as in how do we delivery and operate the solution.

We are working on building a platform team providing horizontal services to vertical feature centric product teams to deliver on Qualio's brand promise - "An easy, scalable and trusted QMS".

How do we work?

We are designing our teams to own specific horizontal areas of our application. Teams are made up of a Product manager (PM), Engineering team lead and a team of engineers. Owning the area of application means everything, collaborating with product managers, customer success partners, architecture, peer engineering teams to deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to our customers.

As Werner Vogels says, "You build it, you run it".

What do we value?

In order to make this a reality we value a number of things:

  • Iterative development - Solutions are delivered as a collection of small pieces. No big bangs.
  • Test driven development
  • Clean code
  • Automation in all its forms - tests, infrastructure, build and deploy - everything
  • "Done" means it's in the hands of customers

What’s the opportunity?

As Qualio continues to grow, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join one of our platform teams. We have a new feature area that is growing beyond an MVP.

We are predominantly a Python shop, but we also use Node.js, TypeScript, React, AngularJS, REST APIs and host our cloud software in AWS, but we’re open to developers who have expertise in different languages as long as you're open to learning!

What will I be doing?

  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset
  • Partner with team in designing, implementing and delivering effective cloud based solutions - evidenced by timeliness, quality, usability, operational stability, performance, and success of meeting customer requirements/business objectives
  • Ability to maintain a proactive and positive attitude in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • You like the sound of working for a fully remote-based organization with lots of opportunities

What skills do I need?

  • You have 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Utilize programming languages like Python, Node.js, RDBMS and NoSQL databases.
  • Well-versed with AWS Cloud based services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, and related technologies e.g. ELB, API Gateway, Security groups, VPCs, etc
  • Well-versed with OpenSearch
  • You can code, conduct reviews on architecture and code along with other team members to build effective software
  • Apply engineering best practices in TDD, clean code, CI/CD to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support product solutions
  • Experience with Agile methodologies/DevSecOps environment
  • Breadth and depth of experience in areas like application platforms, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, data management, and infrastructure as code
  • Actively use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate your work, whether writing code, debugging, or prototyping, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't in an engineering context.

In addition to playing an important role in building Qualio, you'll receive:

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible holidays
  • Flexible time off policy
  • Professional development stipend
  • Working space allowance / home office budget
  • Opportunity to make a difference through helping life-saving products to get to market

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Set-Up: Private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with reliable internet
  • Key Skills:
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly in maintaining documentation

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $40,000 - $46,000 (commensurate with experience)
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and company-observed holidays
  • Continuing education and professional development opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment

Why Clinicians Choose Affect

  • 100% remote clinical work
  • Predictable schedules and realistic caseloads
  • Support and collaboration across teams
  • Mission-driven work
  • Opportunity to help build the future of accessible addiction and mental health care

Who Thrives at Affect

  • People who value evidence-based, recovery-oriented care
  • People seeking meaningful work with better work-life balance

Your lived experience of recovery is a strength at Affect. Join us and be part of the Affect mission.

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

  • Move customers from basic to advanced usage, such as CI integration and Cloud Pods, with LocalStack embedded in their engineering workflows.

  • Grow accounts organically by identifying new teams and use cases, including Azure and Snowflake, and driving adoption of new product releases.

  • Run each account with a clear success plan and work in step with the TAM, AE and Product, while helping refine our playbooks and KPIs.

✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role

  • 5+ years in Customer Success or account management at a SaaS company, preferably in developer tooling or DevOps-focused SaaS, 2+ years managing enterprise clients

  • Experience managing a book of 20-30 accounts, working with stakeholders from individual engineers to engineering managers and directors.

  • Has led renewals through procurement end to end, including commercial terms, pricing conversations and negotiation, with a solid grasp of the commercial side of the role.

  • Track record of strong retention (e.g., GRR) and growing customer adoption.

  • Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

  • Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

  • Competitive salary

  • Private medical and 401k

  • Annual company retreat

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)

LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.

Senior Software Engineer: Platform

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer: Platform, you will design and scale the foundational APIs and backend services powering LogicGate’s Risk Cloud platform. As enterprise GRC demands expand, you will tackle critical system bottlenecks, optimize cloud data stores, and ensure high-availability multi-tenant reliability. Working in Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, and AWS, you will solve complex architectural challenges while elevating technical standards across the engineering chapter. In this role, your technical leadership will directly ensure our platform remains scalable, resilient, and performant.

What You’ll Do

  • System & Data Architecture: Design and build high-throughput backend services, core platform APIs, and distributed data stores using Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ to expand multi-tenant Risk Cloud capabilities.
  • Quality & Continuous Delivery: Write robust unit, integration, and service-level tests while partnering with DevOps to evolve cloud infrastructure and automated CI/CD pipelines (AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitLab CI).
  • Observability & Optimization: Monitor operational metrics, tracing, and alerts in Datadog to proactively diagnose system bottlenecks, optimize database query performance, and ensure platform health.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Facilitate technical design reviews, decompose complex epics alongside Product and Design teams, and mentor engineers across squads to elevate code quality and execution.
  • AI Workflow Efficiency: Leverage AI coding assistants, LLMs, and modern developer automation tools to streamline engineering workflows, refactor legacy patterns, and accelerate feature delivery velocity.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Backend Expertise: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise backend systems using Java, Kotlin, or comparable JVM languages with Spring Boot.
  • Distributed & Cloud Systems: Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining high-scale distributed systems and RESTful APIs in an AWS cloud-native environment.
  • Data & Storage Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with relational or non-relational databases, caching mechanisms, and asynchronous message brokers (e.g., PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ).
  • Testing & Quality First: Deep commitment to modern testing practices across the testing pyramid, treating test automation as an essential component of shipping software.
  • AI Literacy & Agentic Tooling: Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience leveraging modern AI coding tools, LLMs, or AI agents (e.g., custom developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated assistants) to enhance problem-solving, code quality, and engineering velocity.
  • Distributed Work & Team Engagement: Thrives in a remote, highly collaborative engineering culture with willingness to attend occasional department onsites and company events.

Nice to Have:

  • LogicGate Tech Stack: Direct hands-on experience with LogicGate’s tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Terraform, and GitLab CI.
  • Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with graph database modeling, event-driven architectures, or multi-tenant SaaS application design.
  • Full-Stack & SDLC Leadership: Brings a holistic perspective to the software development life cycle - combining deep backend expertise with a desire to work across the stack, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and apply infrastructure-as-code (IaC) best practices.

The anticipated base salary range for the role is $125,000 - $165,000 per year + variable + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.

jobs.description:
About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming. We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.

We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.

We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

The role

We are building the frontend of a multi-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on.

We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi-brand platform, with no spec handed to you.

  • Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand-specific code, all on a live product.

  • Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI-assisted prototyping all draw from.

  • Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable.

  • Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them.

  • Ship consumer-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility.

  • Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections.

About You:

  • 8+ years building production consumer-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership.

  • You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’.

  • AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it.

  • Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice.

  • Hands-on experience building or re-architecting multi-brand, multi-tenant or white-label frontends.

  • You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance.

  • Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked.

  • Comfortable working with non-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable.

  • Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production.

  • You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time, high-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter.

  • Background in fintech, crypto, real-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high-traffic consumer products.

  • Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system.

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments.

What this role is not

  • Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship.

  • Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day.

  • Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting.

What kind of culture can I expect?
Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

jobs.excerpt: Job Purpose: The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration is a senior, customer-facing technical contributor responsible for ensuring customers successfully integrate and get value from IMS's mobile SDKs, which power telematics, mobility, and insurance technology solutions.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration is a senior, customer-facing technical contributor responsible for ensuring customers successfully integrate and get value from IMS's mobile SDKs, which power telematics, mobility, and insurance technology solutions. Working primarily post-sales, this role acts as the technical bridge between IMS and its customers' mobile development teams, owning SDK integrations from kick-off through go-live and beyond across native iOS and Android and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). The role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, making independent technical and customer-facing decisions, and to proactively shape how IMS supports and delivers SDK integrations.

This position is ideal for an experienced mobile SDK developer, or an experienced app developer with strong SDK integration experience, who also brings consultative, customer-facing experience who enjoys a balance of hands-on coding and advising others. The successful candidate will be comfortable working inside customer codebases to diagnose and resolve integration issues, explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and using real-world customer insight to drive improvements to IMS's SDK, support model, and delivery processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer SDK Integration & Delivery

  • Independently own the technical delivery of IMS SDK integrations for customers, from technical kick-off and environment setup through testing, go-live, and early-life support.
  • Guide customer engineering teams through integrating the IMS SDK into native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, including SDK components built with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Advise customers on SDK configuration for trip detection, crash detection, and related features, including the appropriate setup for phone-only, Bluetooth-enabled device, and OBD-based use cases.
  • Support customers in implementing SDK authentication and user session management, including token-based (e.g. JWT) authentication flows.
  • Build sample code, reference implementations, and proof-of-concept apps to help customers adopt SDK features quickly and correctly.
  • Ensure customers correctly implement platform permissions and background behaviour (location, motion, Bluetooth, notifications) required for reliable data capture.

Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Support

  • Independently diagnose and resolve complex customer integration issues by reviewing customer code, SDK logs, device behaviour, and backend data.
  • Reproduce customer-reported issues across devices, OS versions, and frameworks, and determine whether the root cause sits in the customer app, the SDK, or the platform.
  • Act as the senior technical point of contact for customer escalations relating to SDK integrations, working with the Service Desk and engineering teams to drive issues to resolution.
  • Raise clear, well-evidenced defect reports and feature requests for the SDK engineering teams, including reproduction steps and supporting data.
  • Contribute fixes or improvements to SDK wrappers, sample apps, and integration tooling where appropriate.

Customer Consultation & Enablement

  • Build trusted technical relationships with customer engineering teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Run technical workshops, integration reviews, and onboarding sessions to help customers understand SDK capabilities, best practices, and trade-offs.
  • Advise customers on mobile best practices that affect telematics data quality, such as battery optimisation, background execution limits, and OS-specific restrictions.
  • Translate customer business requirements into practical technical integration approaches.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, setting realistic expectations on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Process Improvement & Technical Leadership

  • Proactively identify gaps and inefficiencies in SDK support and delivery processes, and propose and drive practical improvements.
  • Make independent decisions on integration approaches, issue prioritisation, and customer recommendations, escalating only where business or product impact requires it.
  • Define and evolve repeatable integration playbooks, onboarding checklists, and support standards that scale across customers.
  • Recommend measures of integration and support effectiveness, such as time-to-integrate and escalation volumes, and use them to guide improvements.
  • Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across Engineering, Service Desk, and Customer Success on SDK integration and troubleshooting.
  • Influence the SDK roadmap by presenting evidence-based recommendations to Engineering and Product leadership.

Product Feedback & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with SDK Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, and Account Management to ensure a smooth customer integration experience.
  • Capture recurring integration challenges and customer needs, and feed them back into the SDK roadmap and product decisions.
  • Partner with engineering teams to validate new SDK releases with customers and support customers through version upgrades and migrations.

Documentation, Tooling & Continuous Improvement

  • Create and maintain integration guides, FAQs, troubleshooting playbooks, and knowledge base content for customers and internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the SDK integration experience and reduce time-to-integrate for new customers.
  • Help improve internal processes for customer onboarding, issue triage, and knowledge sharing, including the use of AI-assisted tools where they add value.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile application development for iOS and/or Android in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift (iOS) and/or Kotlin (Android), with a solid understanding of app lifecycle, permissions, and background processing.
  • Experience developing mobile SDKs or libraries for use by other developers (ideal), or substantial experience integrating third-party SDKs into mobile applications.
  • Experience working with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) in production iOS and/or Android projects.
  • Proven experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, integration support, or professional services.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth or JWT.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including analysing logs and reproducing issues across devices and OS versions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, make sound independent decisions, and manage multiple customer integrations and priorities at once.
  • A track record of proactively improving technical support, delivery, or customer onboarding processes.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with React Native, including native modules and bridges to iOS and Android code.
  • Familiarity with Flutter and platform channels.
  • Experience in telematics, IoT, insurance technology, fleet management, or connected mobility applications.
  • Familiarity with location services, motion sensors, Bluetooth, and other device sensors used for data capture.
  • Experience supporting B2B customers or partners integrating a developer platform, SDK, or API product.
  • Experience creating developer documentation, sample apps, or technical training materials.
  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms, and with tools for log analysis and monitoring.
  • Experience working with global, distributed teams and customers across different time zones.

Other Contextual Information:

  • Remote role based in the United Kingdom or Canada (Ontario).
  • Primarily post-sales, with occasional involvement in pre-sales technical discussions where needed.
  • Occasional travel to IMS offices or customer sites may be required for onboarding, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
  • Some flexibility in working hours may be needed to support customers in different time zones and during critical customer go-lives.

jobs.title: Laravel/IoT Developer
jobs.excerpt: DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day – and for our alarm signalling customers, that promise depends on hardware and software working together flawlessly.
jobs.description:
DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day – and for our alarm signalling customers, that promise depends on hardware and software working together flawlessly. This role owns IoT and alarm signalling hardware integrations and device connectivity for DT ARC, bridging the gap between hardware and software to support new engineering requests as well as repair and manufacturing workflows.
Given the safety-critical nature of alarm signalling, this role needs a security-conscious approach and the confidence to troubleshoot issues that span both hardware and software.
As a specialist within the ARC development team who brings dedicated IoT experience, you will bridge the gap between physical hardware engineering and our operational monitoring platforms. Working alongside embedded firmware engineers, product managers, and software peers, you will ingest and map device telemetry, sensor feeds, and remote MQTT commands into our central Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC) platform and DTCommand client portal.
You will translate device-level hardware capabilities (such as geolocation) into intuitive, dependable controls and visual states for our 24/7 ARC operators. Furthermore, you will drive the iterative evolution of device features—progressing capabilities from basic on/off toggles and timed schedules through to smart, telemetry-driven automations and workflows.
ABOUT DETERTECH
DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values – Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious – shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.

This is a remote role, with the flexibility to work from home. We also value face-to-face collaboration and would ask for some flexibility to attend occasional in-person meetings or team sessions.

Key Responsibilities

1. IoT and hardware integration
• Build and maintain software integrations with IoT and hardware devices, including alarm signalling equipment, sensors and gateways.
• Apply relevant signalling protocols and standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).
• Ingest, decode, and process device telemetry and command topics (via MQTT, WebSockets, and TCP/UDP sockets) published by embedded hardware and firmware engineering teams.
• Map raw device states, diagnostic health metrics, and sensor data into operational database schemas and real-time ARC monitoring views.
• Implement resilient bidirectional messaging pipelines to dispatch remote control commands, configuration updates, and firmware state synchronisations over cellular and IoT networks.
2. Application development & iterative feature engineering
• Build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring using strong Laravel/PHP skills.
• Use MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity where appropriate.
• Implement responsive operator interfaces and control panels within the ARC platform and DTCommand, translating UI/UX wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design specs provided by the Lead Digital Product Designer into functional frontend components and backend APIs
• Drive the phased, iterative evolution of hardware features in close alignment with the Head of Product and Lead Digital Product Designer—progressing device commands from simple manual toggles to rule-based timed intervals, telemetry-driven thresholds, and machine-learning assisted automations.
• Architect and scale background queue consumers to process high-frequency device heartbeats, pings, and alarm events with minimal latency.
• Build and maintain secure RESTful and event-driven APIs connecting device management services with the core ARC platform, DTCommand client portal, and mobile applications.
3. Troubleshooting and support
• Troubleshoot issues across the hardware/software boundary, working with engineering, repair and manufacturing colleagues as needed.
• Partner closely with hardware and embedded firmware engineers to define clear interface contracts, payload schemas, and MQTT topic structures for emerging device revisions and product features.

• Develop diagnostic utilities and device provisioning scripts to empower manufacturing and repair technicians to test, flash, configure, and certify equipment efficiently.
• Investigate complex telemetry anomalies, packet dropouts, and handshake timeouts in collaboration with relevant teams.

• Provide tier-3 technical escalation support for live signalling faults, identifying whether root causes stem from firmware bugs, cellular network carriers, protocol decoding, or backend application logic and work with relevant teams to support and fix.
4. Security, compliance and reliability
• Apply a security-conscious approach to device connectivity, reflecting the critical, safety-related nature of alarm signalling.

• Implement strict security standards across all device communications, including transport encryption (TLS/mTLS), secure token/credential rotation, and mutual authentication.
• Ensure signalling architectures comply with alarm industry standards (such as BS EN 50131 / BS 5979 / PD 6662) and data privacy regulations (GDPR).
• Establish monitoring, synthetic health checks, and alerting on device listener sockets and broker connections to detect dropouts or network degradation proactively.

5. Sprint delivery and platform collaboration
• Participate actively in Agile sprint meeting with the Technical Delivery Manager, delivering predictable milestones on product engineering initiatives.
• Partner with the Lead Full Stack Developer for architectural guidance, code reviews, and API schema design to ensure IoT components integrate cleanly into the wider Laravel ecosystem.
• Collaborate closely with the Lead Digital Product Designer to review user interaction models, technical feasibility of UI components, and stateful feedback loops.
• Liaise with the MuleSoft / Integration team to ensure device information from manufacturing and repair configurations can be synchronised.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential
• Experience integrating software with IoT/hardware devices (for example alarm signalling equipment, sensors, gateways).
• Understanding of relevant signalling protocols/standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).
• Strong Laravel/PHP skills to build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring.
• Comfortable troubleshooting issues across the hardware/software boundary.
• A security-conscious approach to device connectivity, given the critical nature of alarm signalling.
• Background developing web applications, microservices, or daemons in modern PHP/Laravel (including queue workers, and event broadcasting).
• Practical experience working with MQTT, WebSockets, or publish/subscribe messaging architectures for device connectivity and telemetry ingestion.
• Demonstrated ability to translate raw hardware sensor data (telemetry, environmental inputs, battery budgets) into functional software applications and clear visual states.
• Familiarity with appropriate databases and caching/queue technologies for high-volume event processing.

• Collaborative team player, comfortable working across disciplines with embedded firmware engineers, product managers, digital designers, and manufacturing/repair technicians.

Desirable
• Experience with MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity.
• Experience in the security, alarm or IoT hardware industry.
• Familiarity with frontend technologies commonly used in the Laravel ecosystem (such as Livewire or React).
• Familiarity with cellular IoT connectivity (e.g. roaming M2M SIMs, APNs, bandwidth budgets, and AT commands).
• Practical experience using hardware diagnostic tools to debug issues.
• Familiarity with AWS cloud services (such as EC2, ECS, Lambda, or IoT Core).
• Exposure to manufacturing workflows, hardware provisioning tools.

We are committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

jobs.description:
Our Journey

The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific’s leading shopping, rewards, and payments platform, serving over 20 million active members across 13 markets. In 2025, the Group continued its global growth with its expansion into North America. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack is dedicated to saving members money and time, and delivering delight every day. The platform also enables merchants and brands to engage with their members in a cost-effective manner. Founded in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales for over 20,000 online and in-store partners, and has rewarded shoppers with more than US$900 million (over S$1 billion) in Cashback to date. Through its innovative offerings, ShopBack continues to create value for both members and merchants. Notably, its payment solution, ShopBack Pay, offers members a convenient and rewarding payment option at checkout.
As a ShopBack intern, you do real work and deliver real impact. You ship code that goes to production and is used by millions of members all over the world. AI agents are part of how we build every day, so you will orchestrate and build with them from day one.

What You'll Own

  • Ship real features. You own a scoped project, from design to production, with a mentor who supports you.
  • Build with AI as a teammate. You use coding agents to move fast, and you learn to review, test, and verify what they produce.
  • Make AI tools for others. You build a skill, a tool, or an agent workflow that your team keeps using after your internship ends.
  • Measure, don't guess. You write evals and tests so you can prove that your AI-powered work is good.

Essentials to Succeed

  • You have good fundamentals. You can write clean code, you are familiar with design patterns, and you understand data structures, APIs, and testing.
  • You have built things outside of class. Side projects, hackathons, open source, and freelance work all count.
  • You have applied AI, not only chatted with it. What have you built? Tell us about an app on an LLM API, a custom agent or MCP server, a boring task you automated end to end, or a simple eval you used to compare prompts or models.
  • You stay curious and sceptical. You ask why the AI gave an answer, and you check it before you trust it.
  • You learn fast. You are excited to learn new things. You are comfortable when you do not know something yet, and you ask good questions.

Show Us What You Built with AI

    Tell us about:

  • The coolest one: the thing you are most proud of, or the thing that made people say "wait, how?"
  • Or the hardest one: the thing that broke many times before it worked.

    • For each one, tell us:

  • The problem: what you wanted to solve, and why it mattered to you.
  • What you built: what you built, compared to what the AI did.
  • What broke: where the AI failed, and how you found and fixed the problem.
  • The result: a link to a repo, a demo, a video, or a write-up. A result that works with rough edges is better than slides that look polished.

    • Start where the problem is real. A personal agent that saves your time 10 minutes every day is better than a big idea that nobody built. Build it, ship it, and let people use it.

Bonus Points

  • Agents: you built an agent that uses tools, keeps memory, or runs many steps without a human.
  • Evals: you wrote evals or tests to measure whether your AI output improved.
  • Real users: you shipped something that people other than you actually use.
  • Cloud: you deployed your project to a cloud platform.
    • We are looking for builders who are curious about AI and make a real impact with it.

Technologies You'll Touch

  • TypeScript / Node.js
  • Postgres
  • Kafka
  • Kubernetes
  • GitLab
  • Datadog
  • Claude Code
  • MCP

ShopBacker Traits

  • Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
  • Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
  • Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
  • Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

What's in it for ShopBackers

  • Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
  • Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale.
  • Competitive compensation based on performance.
  • Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
jobs.excerpt: Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

Our Agents team at Muck Rack is building AI for PR and communications professionals. Our first agent helps customers understand their media coverage. Next, we’re building agents that can plan and carry out multi-step workflows.

You’ll take features from idea to production, working across our Python agent runtime, MCP server, and Django/Vue application. You’ll help decide how the technology works, ship it to real customers, and learn from how they use it.

You’ll help shape what we build next and how we build it. You’ll work with new models, solve real customer problems, and take your ideas from experiment to production. If you want to build agents people actually rely on, we’d like to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Build agents that take action. Build tools, prompts, guardrails, and multi-turn workflows with memory. Help agents know when to act, ask a question, or hand off to a human
  • Ship the full experience. Build in-product chat, streaming responses, permission-aware APIs, and our external MCP server
  • Make quality measurable. Build evals, catch regressions, and use production feedback to improve quality, latency, and cost
  • Help shape the platform. Make decisions about how we build, deploy, and run agents as the product grows

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have

  • 7+ years building production software
  • Fluent Python skills, including async programming and experience with FastAPI, FastMCP, or Django
  • Experience shipping LLM-powered features or agents to real customers including exposing tools via MCP
  • A practical understanding of prompting, tool use, context management, and where models go wrong
  • Experience measuring AI quality and using what you learn to improve it
  • Strong API and tool design skills, including authentication and authorization
  • Proactively incorporates AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery
  • Working-hour overlap with US time zones (Eastern preferred)

If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity

  • Agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, or the OpenAI Agents SDK
  • MCP servers and LLM tooling
  • AI evaluation tools and methods, including DeepEval and LLM-as-judge
  • Streaming UIs, server-sent events, and Vue.js
  • Experience with LLM observability
  • AI security, including prompt injection defenses and tenant isolation

Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  • 30-minute interview with a member of our Talent Team
  • A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager
  • Peer interviews with several team members
  • 30-minute Executive Interview
  • 30-minute Bar Raiser

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

  • The anticipated salary range for this role in Ireland is €95,000–€110,000 annually, depending on experience.
  • The anticipated salary range for this role in United Kingdom is £105,000–£115,000 annually, depending on experience.
  • The anticipated salary for this role in Bulgaria is €6,500+ gross per month, depending on experience.
Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

  • Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup
  • Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership
  • Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

  • Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.
  • Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment
  • Standardized bonus or commission structure
  • 401(k) with employer contributions
  • Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents
  • 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans
  • 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program
  • Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits
  • Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

  • 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days
  • 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

  • Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion
  • Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training
  • Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly
  • 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

  • Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives
  • Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation
  • Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

While we are a fully distributed team, we do have limitations on where we can hire and maintain a list of acceptable working locations based on job function. If we are unable to hire in your current location for the role for which you applied, you will be notified via email. While we enjoy many benefits as a permanently distributed and remote company, we cannot always support relocation or extended travel and have guidelines in place to ensure compliant work away from your designated permanent residence.

Please note: For detailed information regarding our GDPR and/or CCPA compliance policies, including how we handle personal data and privacy rights, kindly refer to the email correspondence accompanying this application.
Muck Rack does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or any other third parties. Any unsolicited resume sent to Muck Rack will be considered Muck Rack property, and Muck Rack will not pay a fee should it hire the subject of any unsolicited resume.
Muck Rack considers applicants for all positions on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs, and without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, alienage or citizenship status, ancestry, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Note to applicants/job seekers: We have recently been made aware of scams impersonating Muck Rack’s HR team. Please be cautious of these attempts to elicit banking or other financial or sensitive information. Muck Rack will never request financial information during the interview process, and follow ups for interviews or next steps will always come from an ‘@muckrack.com’ email address. If you are contacted by anyone from a different domain who claims to be from Muck Rack, please forward the communication to .
